prophets|title: Azmz n lanbiya d rrusul d lktub n ignna
prophets|subtitle: Zɣ Adam ɣifs ssalam ar Ɛisa ɣifs ssalam
prophets|summary: Sḍiṣ d ɛcrin n nnbi d rrasul ɣ yat tsnsla n ttawḥid, nttni d lktub n ignna: Ṣṣuḥuf n Ibrahim d Musa, Ttawrat, Zzabur, d Linjil.
prophets/first-fathers/adam|subtitle: Baba n bnadm d amzwaru n lanbiya
prophets/first-fathers/adam|lines.0: Adɣar d ṣṣifa: ixlq t Llah s ufus nns, iṣuḍ ɣifs zɣ rruḥ nns, issujd as lmalayka nns, isslmd as ismawn akkʷ.
prophets/first-fathers/adam|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: tanbaḍt ɣ wakal, tagi n Iblis d ttkbbr nns, akayad n tsklut n ljnnt d lwswasa, ukan ttuba d usti ﴿فَتَلَقّ۪ىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَٰتٖ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِۖ﴾.
prophets/first-fathers/adam|lines.2: Tiwṣṣatin d lktub: asnti n ttawḥid d tiwṣṣatin tizwura, d ttuba d listiɣfar.
prophets/first-fathers/sheth|lines.0: Adɣar d ṣṣifa: mmi-s n Adam d lxlifa nns ɣ wakal, d lwṣiy nns ɣ tḥḍa n tarwa nns d uḥḍu n ccrɛ n ttawḥid.
prophets/first-fathers/sheth|lines.1: Asatal: tamttla n tsutiwin n imwaḥḥidn f ttawḥid iṣfan mraw n lqrun gr Adam d Nuḥ.
prophets/first-fathers/idris|lines.0: Adɣar d ṣṣifa: nnbi ikrmn ifulki t Llah s tidt d ṣṣbr, imun dids nnbi ﷺ ɣ ignna wis kkuẓ ɣ yiḍ n lmiɛraj.
prophets/first-fathers/idris|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: tidt d nnubuwwa d tullya n lmqam ﴿وَاذْكُرْ فِے اِ۬لْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقاٗ نَّبِيٓـٔاٗۖ * وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَاناً عَلِيّاًۖ﴾.
prophets/first-fathers/idris|lines.2: Ṣṣbr: ﴿وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا اَ۬لْكِفْلِۖ كُلّٞ مِّنَ اَ۬لصَّٰبِرِينَۖ﴾.
prophets/first-messengers|title: Nuḥ, amzwaru n rrusul, d igdudn imzwura
prophets/first-messengers/nuh|subtitle: Amzwaru n rrusul d amqqran n imrsal
prophets/first-messengers/nuh|lines.0: Adɣar d ṣṣifa: amzwaru n rrasul lli d iznza Llah ɣ tggira n ccirk ɣ wakal, zɣ ulu lɛazm n rrusul.
prophets/first-messengers/nuh|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: iɣra i ugdud nns ifḍ n useggʷas ɣas smmus d mraw n useggʷas s ṣṣbr d ujhad, iskr lbabbur s lwaḥy n Llah, aṭufan amqqran, aɣrrq n mmi-s lli iɛṣan, d tnjjit n imuminn ﴿وَقِيلَ يَٰٓأَرْضُ اُ۪بْلَعِے مَآءَكِ﴾.
prophets/first-messengers/nuh|lines.2: Tiwṣṣatin: ttawḥid iṣfan, d tbrriyt zɣ ṣṣnam (Wadd, Suwaɛ, Yaɣut, Yaɛuq, d Nasr), d tanmmirt i tiɣufa n Llah.
prophets/first-messengers/hud|lines.0: Agdud d udɣar: iznza t Llah s tqbilt n Ɛad ɣ Lʔaḥqaf (Ḥaḍramawt d unẓul n Tgzirt), ayt lbni ittawin d tadwast.
prophets/first-messengers/hud|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ismktay asn tiɣufa n Llah, ifl asn ttjbbr ﴿أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ اٰيَةٗ تَعْبَثُونَ * وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ﴾.
prophets/first-messengers/hud|lines.2: Taggara: skkrkisn as ugdud d ttkbbr nnsn, ihlk tn Llah s yan waḍu iṣmmiḍn ijhdn ittusxxrn ɣifsn sa n yiḍan d tam n wussan ttmttaḍfarn, ismnjji Llah Hud d wid as umnnin.
prophets/first-messengers/salih|lines.0: Agdud d udɣar: iznza t Llah s Tamud ɣ Lḥijr (agafa n Tgzirt n waɛrabn), wid ittqqazn tiddar ɣ idurar s ufrraḥ.
prophets/first-messengers/salih|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ttrn ugdud yat lmuɛjiza, isufɣ asn Llah tlɣmt d lmuɛjiza ibaynn, iḥḍu tn ad tt ssmmasn s lbas ﴿هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ اُ۬للَّهِ لَكُمُۥٓ ءَايَةٗۖ فَذَرُوهَا تَاكُلْ فِےٓ أَرْضِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ﴾.
prophets/first-messengers/salih|lines.2: Taggara: iɣrṣ asmmaṭṭaw nnsn i tlɣmt ɣ tggira n tḥilt n imqqurn nnsn, ar tn tamẓ tɣuyyit d tergigit, ar asn d iẓru ṣṣbaḥ ɣ tgmmi nnsn ttugrnnin f igʷmmaḍ nnsn.
prophets/ibrahim-house|title: Azmz n Ibrahim ɣifs ssalam d tarwa nns
prophets/ibrahim-house|subtitle: Ibrahim, Luṭ, Cuɛayb, Ismaɛil d Isḥaq, Yaɛqub, Yusuf
prophets/ibrahim-house/ibrahim|subtitle: Xalil Llah d lmam n lḥunafaʔ
prophets/ibrahim-house/ibrahim|lines.0: Ṣṣifa d udɣar: lmam n ttawḥid, ahrraz n ṣṣnam, zɣ ulu lɛazm n rrusul, baba n lanbiya.
prophets/ibrahim-house/ibrahim|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: amsasa nns d win dids imsasan f Rbbi nns, d umsasa nns d ugdud nns, aluḥ nns ɣ tmssi lli as yuɣaln d asmmiḍ d ssalam, lhijra s wakal ibarkn d Makka, abnu n Lkaɛba d Ismaɛil ﴿وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ اُ۬لْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ اَ۬لْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلُۖ﴾, d ukayad n tɣrsi tamqqrant.
prophets/ibrahim-house/ibrahim|lines.2: Lktab lli yuzn Rbbi: Ṣṣuḥuf n Ibrahim ﴿صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوس۪ىٰۖ﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/lut|lines.0: Tamlalt d udɣar: mmi-s n gʷma-s n Ibrahim ɣifs ssalam, iumn dids iḥajr dids, ukan iznza t Llah s ayt Sadum ɣ Ɣawr Lʔurdun.
prophets/ibrahim-house/lut|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ifl asn lfaḥica ixcnn lli ur jjun iskr yan ɣ bnadm dat nsn, ikkat tamnnaɣt nnsn ﴿أَتَاتُونَ اَ۬لْفَٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنَ اَحَدٖ مِّنَ اَ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/lut|lines.2: Taggara: tirzi n lmalayka i Ibrahim ukan i Luṭ, tuffɣa n Luṭ d ayt tgmmi nns s yiḍ, d uhlak n tmṭṭuṭ nns lli iqqimn d ugdud s unẓar n iẓṛan d ubddl n tgmmi nnsn: afella nns iga wadda nns.
prophets/ibrahim-house/shuayb|lines.0: Agdud d udɣar: iznza t Llah s ayt Madyan d ayt Layka (agafa-utaram n Tgzirt n waɛrabn).
prophets/ibrahim-house/shuayb|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ifl asn aẓḍam ɣ lkil d lmizan, d lfsad ɣ wakal d tuxxṛa n ubrid ﴿﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/shuayb|lines.2: Taggara: ttḍṣan gis imqqurn n ugdud nns skkrkisn as, ar tn yamẓ waɛḍab n wass n tdgnut d tergigit n tɣuyyit, ar asn d iẓru ṣṣbaḥ ɣ tgmmi nnsn ttugrnnin zund ur gis jjun llin.
prophets/ibrahim-house/ismail-ishaq|line: Ismaɛil ɣifs ssalam: bab n tidt ɣ lwaɛd, nnbi n Makka, jddi-s n nnbi Muḥammad ﷺ d waɛrabn lmustaɛriba, imun d baba-s ɣ ubnu n Lkaɛba ﴿وَاذْكُرْ فِے اِ۬لْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ اَ۬لْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولاٗ نَّبِيٓـٔاٗ﴾.

Isḥaq ɣifs ssalam: lbcara ibarkn i Sara d Ibrahim ɣ twssirt, nnbi ikrmn, baba-s n Yaɛqub, zɣ tarwa nns a d ttmttaḍfarn lanbiya n Bani Israʔil ﴿وَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِإِسْحَٰقَ نَبِيٓـٔاٗ مِّنَ اَ۬لصَّٰلِحِينَ﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/yaqub|lines.0: Aẓar d udɣar: mmi-s n Isḥaq mmi-s n Ibrahim ɣifsn ssalam, ttinin as «Israʔil», ɣur s ttmunn Bani Israʔil akkʷ d lʔasbaṭ nnsn mraw d sin.
prophets/ibrahim-house/yaqub|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ṣṣbr ifulkin f tbḍḍa d sin tarwa nns Yusuf d Binyamin ﴿فَصَبْرٞ جَمِيلٞۖ وَاللَّهُ اُ۬لْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَۖ﴾, d tilla n lyaqin s rrḥmt n Llah ﴿إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُواْ بَثِّے وَحُزْنِيَ إِلَى اَ۬للَّهِۖ﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/yaqub|lines.2: Tawṣṣit taneggarut: tawṣṣit nns ur itmttaḍn i tarwa nns ɣ lmut, ad bddn f ttawḥid d ddin ilḥnifn ﴿مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنۢ بَعْدِےۖ قَالُواْ نَعْبُدُ إِلَٰهَكَ وَإِلَٰهَ ءَابَآئِكَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ إِلَٰهاٗ وَٰحِداٗ﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/yusuf|lines.0: Aẓar d ṣṣifa: akrim mmi-s n ukrim mmi-s n ukrim mmi-s n ukrim (Yusuf mmi-s n Yaɛqub mmi-s n Isḥaq mmi-s n Ibrahim), ifka as Llah azgn n tifawt d tussna n usfru n tirgitin.
prophets/ibrahim-house/yusuf|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ifulki tiḥkayin; aluḥ nns s wanu s lḥsad zɣ ayt mas, azzenz nns ɣ Maṣr, asnkkr n tmṭṭuṭ n Lɛaziz d ṣṣbr d lɛiffa ɣ lḥbs, asfru n tirgit n ugllid, tanbaḍt f ixzainn n wakal, ukan amun n twacunt d usujd n imawlan d ayt mas, ar tḥqqa tirgit ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّے لَطِيفٞ لِّمَا يَشَآءُۖ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms|title: Zɣ Ayyub ar Lyasaɛ: Ttawrat d Zzabur
prophets/torah-psalms|subtitle: Ayyub, Ḍu Lkifl, Yunus, Musa d Harun, Yucaɛ, Dawud, Sulayman, Ilyas, Lyasaɛ
prophets/torah-psalms/ayyub|lines.0: Lmqam d ṣṣifa: nnbi ikrmn, ifka as Llah ayda d twacunt d tarwa, ukan ijrrb t ɣ tfekka nns d uyda nns d tarwa nns, iṣbr.
prophets/torah-psalms/ayyub|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ṣṣbr amqqran bla acetki i yan ur igin Llah, ar ttiwtn s lmital ɣ ṣṣbr ﴿اِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِراٗۖ نِّعْمَ اَ۬لْعَبْدُۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞۖ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/ayyub|lines.2: Lfrj: ddɛwa nns s uxcuɛ ﴿أَنِّے مَسَّنِيَ اَ۬لضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ اُ۬لرَّٰحِمِينَۖ﴾, yamr as Llah ad ikkat akal s uḍar nns ﴿اُ۟رْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلُۢ بَارِدٞ وَشَرَابٞۖ﴾, irar as Llah ṣṣḥt nns d twacunt nns d zund nttni dids nsn, d rrḥmt d usmktay i wid ittɛbadn.
prophets/torah-psalms/dhulkifl|lines.0: Ṣṣifa d usmktay: ismktay t Llah taɛala ɣ Lqurʔan lkrim d lanbiya, ifulki t s ṣṣbr d ṣṣlaḥ.
prophets/torah-psalms/dhulkifl|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ﴿وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا اَ۬لْكِفْلِۖ كُلّٞ مِّنَ اَ۬لصَّٰبِرِينَۖ * وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُمْ فِے رَحْمَتِنَآۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ اَ۬لصَّٰلِحِينَۖ﴾, d ﴿وَاذْكُرِ اِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا اَ۬لْكِفْلِۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ اَ۬لَاخْي۪ارِۖ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/yunus|subtitle: Ḍu Nnun, bab n uslm amqqran
prophets/torah-psalms/yunus|lines.0: Adɣar d tuznt: iznza t Llah s ayt Ninawa ɣ Lɛiraq, ɣikad ifl lqqis zgisn, iffɣ yuggʷa dat ad as yadn Rbbi nns.
prophets/torah-psalms/yunus|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: tali ɣ lbabbur iɛmmrn, lqurɛa lli ɣifs tḍr, aluḥ nns ɣ ilg d ulmmaẓ nns s uslm.
prophets/torah-psalms/yunus|lines.2: Ddɛwa n lkarb: ttasbiḥ nns d ddɛwa nns ɣ tillas n ilg d yiḍ d tɛbbut n uslm ﴿لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّے كُنتُ مِنَ اَ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَۖ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/yunus|lines.3: Tanjjit d taggara: aluḥ nns ɣ yan wakal ixlan, d tmɣi n tsklut n lyaqṭin ɣifs, d ttuba n ugdud nns lli ssuttin fllasn aɛḍab n lḥcuma ﴿إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُواْ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ اَ۬لْخِزْيِ فِے اِ۬لْحَيَوٰةِ اِ۬لدُّنْي۪ا﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/musa-harun|lines.0: Adɣar d ṣṣifa: Musa, kalim Llah, zɣ ulu lɛazm; d gʷma-s Harun, lwazir nns, bab n yils ifṣṣḥn.
prophets/torah-psalms/musa-harun|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: tga yat zɣ tiḥkayin ugar ittusmmaktayn ɣ Lqurʔan; tlalit nns d uluḥ nns ɣ ilg, tarbit nns ɣ tgmmi n Firɛawn, tuffɣa nns s Madyan, awal n Llah dids ɣ Ṭṭur, tisa n lmuɛjizat d umnaɣ d Firɛawn d isḥḥarn nns, abḍu n ilg d uɣrrq n Firɛawn d iɛskrin nns, d tuḍḍrin n Bani Israʔil kkuẓ id mraw n useggʷas.
prophets/torah-psalms/musa-harun|lines.2: Lktab lli yuzn Rbbi: Ttawrat (ɣ lalwaḥ) ﴿وَكَتَبْنَا لَهُۥ فِے اِ۬لَالْوَاحِ مِن كُلِّ شَےْءٖ مَّوْعِظَةٗ وَتَفْصِيلاٗ لِّكُلِّ شَےْءٖۖ﴾, d Lfurqan d nnura d tifawt.
prophets/torah-psalms/yusha|title: Yucaɛ mmi-s n Nun ɣifs ssalam
prophets/torah-psalms/yusha|subtitle: Bab n lfatḥ n wakal iqddsn
prophets/torah-psalms/yusha|lines.0: Ṣṣifa d uẓar: aɛyyal n Musa d anlmad nns lli dids imunn ɣ ubrid n Majmaɛ Lbaḥrayn bac ad mlqqan d Lxaḍir ﴿وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوس۪ىٰ لِفَت۪يٰهُ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/yusha|lines.1: Taḥkayt d lmqam: nnbi n Llah lli iṭṭfn taɣda n Bani Israʔil ɣ tggira n lmut n Musa d Harun ɣ tuḍḍrin, isawl asn ar lfatḥ n Bayt Lmaqdis d ukcam s wakal iqddsn.
prophets/torah-psalms/yusha|lines.2: Lmuɛjiza: tbdd as tafukt s lamr n Llah ar ismmd lfatḥ, zund mad iwala nnbi ﷺ.
prophets/torah-psalms/dawud|lines.0: Lmqam d ṣṣifa: agllid d nnbi, ifka as Llah yan umsli ifulkin s lḥmd, isslqqu as uzzal ar iskar ddruɛ ijhdn.
prophets/torah-psalms/dawud|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: inɣa Jalut amqqran d nnṣr n Ṭalut ﴿وَقَتَلَ دَاوُۥدُ جَالُوتَ وَءَات۪يٰهُ اُ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لْمُلْكَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ﴾, ttasbiḥ n idurar d igḍaḍ dids ṣṣbaḥ d tadggʷat ﴿يَٰجِبَالُ أَوِّبِے مَعَهُۥ وَالطَّيْرَۖ﴾, d ufṣṣl n lxiṭab ɣ lḥukm.
prophets/torah-psalms/dawud|lines.2: Lktab lli yuzn Rbbi: Zzabur ﴿وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُوراٗۖ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/sulayman|subtitle: Mmi-s n Dawud d ugllid amqqran
prophets/torah-psalms/sulayman|lines.0: Lmqam d ṣṣifa: iwrt Dawud ɣ nnubuwwa d tgldit, ifka as Llah yat tgldit ur ifulkin i yan ɣ tggira nns.
prophets/torah-psalms/sulayman|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: asxxr n waḍu d ljnun d bnadm, afham n tutlayt n lmaxluqat d igḍaḍ (taḥkayt n tbibbit d tgʷḍfit), d taḥkayt n lɛarc n Bilqis tagldit n Saba d usllm nns dids i Llah Rbb lɛalamin ﴿قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّے ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِے وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ لِلهِ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/sulayman|lines.2: Abrid: tanmmirt i tiɣufa d ttwaḍuɛ i Ugllid n tidt ﴿هَٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّے لِيَبْلُوَنِيَ ءَآشْكُرُ أَمَ اَكْفُرُۖ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/ilyas|lines.0: Aẓar d udɣar: nnbi zɣ lanbiya n Bani Israʔil, iznza t Llah s ayt Baɛlabak ɣ Ccam.
prophets/torah-psalms/ilyas|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ifl i ugdud nns aɛbad n ṣṣnm (Baɛl), iɣra tn s Rbb lɛalamin ﴿أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلاٗ وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ اَ۬لْخَٰلِقِينَۖ * اَ۬للَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ اُ۬لَاوَّلِينَۖ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/ilyas|lines.2: Afulki n Lqurʔan: iskkrkis as ugdud nns ar ttqqan aɛḍab, iḥḍu Llah asmktay nns i dima ﴿﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/alyasa|lines.0: Lmqam d uẓar: amddakkʷl n Ilyas ɣifs ssalam d lxlifa nns ɣ uɣra n Bani Israʔil s nnhj d ccrɛ.
prophets/torah-psalms/alyasa|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: afulki ifulkin ɣifs d lanbiya ifulkin ﴿وَاذْكُرِ اِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا اَ۬لْكِفْلِۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ اَ۬لَاخْي۪ارِۖ﴾, d usmmuqqr nns f lɛalamin ɣ lfaḍl d liman ﴿وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطاٗۖ وَكُلّاٗ فَضَّلْنَا عَلَى اَ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ﴾.
prophets/gospel|title: Zakariya d Yaḥya d Ɛisa: Linjil
prophets/gospel|subtitle: Zakariya d Yaḥya, Ɛisa mmi-s n Maryam
prophets/gospel/zakariya-yahya|lines.0: Zakariya ɣifs ssalam: bab n tḥḍa n Maryam ɣ lmiḥrab, ddɛwa nns s uffr ɣ twssirt ﴿رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِے فَرْداٗ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ اُ۬لْوَٰرِثِينَۖ﴾, ar as ttuwalan s Yaḥya.
prophets/gospel/zakariya-yahya|lines.1: Yaḥya ɣifs ssalam: nnbi, ssid, lḥaṣur, ifulkin d imawlan nns, ifka as Llah lḥukm ɣ temẓi nns, iṭṭf Ttawrat s tdwast ﴿يَٰيَحْي۪ىٰ خُذِ اِ۬لْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٖۖ﴾.
prophets/gospel/isa|title: Ɛisa mmi-s n Maryam ɣifs ssalam
prophets/gospel/isa|lines.0: Lmqam d ṣṣifa: awal n Llah d rruḥ zɣ ɣurs, ilul zɣ yat tfrut tazddgt bla baba d lmuɛjiza i lɛalamin, zɣ ulu lɛazm n rrusul.
prophets/gospel/isa|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: awal nns ɣ ukrrus iga arba, lmuɛjizat n ujjiy n iddrɣl d ubrṣ d usdr n immutn s lidn n Llah d uxlaq n igḍaḍ zɣ talaxt, tiḥilt n usṣlb nns, d tnjjit nns d tullya nns s ignna ﴿وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ وَمَا صَلَبُوهُ وَلَٰكِن شُبِّهَ لَهُمْۖ﴾ … ﴿بَل رَّفَعَهُ اُ۬للَّهُ إِلَيْهِۖ﴾.
prophets/gospel/isa|lines.2: Lktab lli yuzn Rbbi: Linjil, ar issḥqqa Ttawrat lli dat s illan, ar ibccr s Bab n tggira n rrusul ﴿وَمُبَشِّراَۢ بِرَسُولٖ يَاتِے مِنۢ بَعْدِيَ اَ۪سْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُۖ﴾.
seal|title: Tasurft n nnubuwwa: Muḥammad ﷺ, bab n tggira n lanbiya, d Lqurʔan lkrim
seal|subtitle: Zɣ tlalit ar asmmd n ddin
seal|lines.0: Lmqam d ṣṣifa: bab n tggira n lanbiya d rrusul, rrḥmt i lɛalamin, lmam n imttqin, bab n ccfaɛa tamqqrant d lḥawḍ lli ttaskan.
seal|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: asnti n lwaḥy ɣ Ɣar Ḥiraʔ («Ɣr»), abayyn n ddɛwa, Lisraʔ d Lmiɛraj, lhijra d ubnu n lumma, ljihad ɣ ubrid n Llah, d usmmd n tɣufut ﴿اِ۬لْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ﴾.
seal|lines.2: Lktab lli yuzn Rbbi: Lqurʔan lkrim; aneggaru n lktub n ignna, lmuɛjiza lli ur itmttaḍn, lmhimin f lktub lli t izwarn, ittuḥḍa s uḥḍu n Llah ikmmln ar ass n lqiyama ﴿إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا اَ۬لذِّكْرَۖ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَۖ﴾.
seal/mawlid|title: Aseggʷas n ilu — Tlalit n nnbi
seal/mawlid|lines.1: Aẓar: Muḥammad mmi-s n Ɛbd Llah mmi-s n Ɛbd Lmuṭṭalib mmi-s n Hacim, zɣ Qurayc
seal/mawlid|lines.2: Ayenna iḍrn: tlalit n nnbi ﷺ ɣ useggʷas n ilu
seal/bitha|title: Lbiɛta — asnti n lwaḥy (ɣ 40 n useggʷas)
seal/bitha|lines.1: Ayenna iḍrn: tazdart n lwaḥy d usnti n tuznt
seal/bitha|lines.2: Amzwaru n ma d iḍrn: asnti n ssurt n Lɛalaq («Ɣr s yism n Rbbi nnk lli ixlqn»)
seal/makki|lines.0: Tiɣzi: 13 n useggʷas (zɣ 40 ar 53 n useggʷas n umud)
seal/makki|lines.2: Agbur agejdan: asjhd n lɛaqida d ttawḥid
seal/makki|lines.4: Ayenna iḍrn ugar: abayyn n ddɛwa, lhijra s Lḥabaca, lḥiṣar ɣ Ciɛb Abi Ṭalib, aseggʷas n lḥzn, Lisraʔ d Lmiɛraj d ufrḍ n smmus n tẓallit, d sin lbayɛat n Lɛaqaba
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d1|b0|text: Isslmd Llah imsxxarn nns mamnk a s ttinign
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d1|b0.0|text: Attwssl s ɣurs s ismawn nns d ṣṣifat nns
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d1|b0.0.1|text: Asmktay n ṣṣifat n Lʔuluhiya d Rrububiya d rrḥmt d tgldit
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d1|b0.0.2|text: Tussna s is ssmm ar inɣa ur ttili d tussna n tidt abla s ugdal nns
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d1|b0.1|text: Attwssl s ɣurs s lɛubudiya nns
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d2|b0.0.0|text: Iswi nnsn aɛbad n Llah, ar ttinign lɛawn dar Llah ad tn iwfffq ad t skrn
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d2|b0.0.1|text: Ar ttɣilin is ttuflan i yiman nnsn ɣ lɛibadat nnsn bla afus n Llah, wala s ttawfiq n win isti liman wala s ttxlliya n win isti lkufr; ar fllas ttzaggʷarn i ujdur n lɛibada, lli iga listiɛana
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d2|b0.0.2|label: Ur Iyyaka naɛbudu, walaynni Iyyaka nastaɛin
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d2|b0.0.2|text: Ar ttinign lɛawn dar Llah bac ad amẓn amur nnsn d tiɣuṭṭas nnsn d lɣaraḍ nnsn n ddunit ɣas
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d2|b0.0.3|label: Ur Iyyaka naɛbudu, ur Iyyaka nastaɛin
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d2|b0.0.3|text: Wid iggiwn i lɛibada nns d listiɛana s
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d2|b0.1.0|text: Lxdmt nnsn ɣ ufella d ugensu i wudm n Llah waḥdut, ar timsasa d ccrɛ
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d2|b0.1.1|text: Zund ijahiln n wid ittɛbadn, zund win iɣaln is lxlwa lli ɣ ittaǧǧa ljjemɛa d ljmaɛa tqrrab s Llah
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d2|b0.1.2|text: Zund ṭṭaɛa n wid ittmrayan, lli skarn tigawin ifulkin ɣ ufella, walaynni ar tnt skarn bac ad tn ẓṛn mddn
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d2|b0.1.3|text: Lxdmt nnsn ur tṣfa i Win ittyaɛbadn, ur timsasa d ccrɛ
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d3|b0|text: F kkuẓ ad: Llah, d Rrbb, d Rraḥman Rraḥim, d Lmalik
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d3|b0.0|text: Lxaliq, Lbariʔ, Lmuṣawwir, Rrazzaq, Lmuɛṭi, Lmaniɛ, Ḍḍarr, Nnafiɛ, Lqabiḍ, Lbasiṭ
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d3|b0.1|text: Llaṭif, Lɣafur, Ccakur, Lkarim, Lḥalim, Lwadud, Lḥamid, Lbarr, Ttawwab, Lɛafuww, Rraʔuf
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d3|b0.2|text: Lḥakam, Lɛadl, Lxabir, Lɛaḍim, Lɛaliy, Lkabir, Lḥafiḍ, Lmuqit, Lḥasib, Rraqib, Lmujib, Lwasiɛ, Lmajid, Ccahid, Lḥaqq, Lwakil, Lqawiy, Lwaliy, Lqayyum, Lqadir, Lmuqtadir, Lmutaɛali, Malik Lmulk, Lmuqsiṭ, Ljamiɛ, Lɣaniy
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d4|b0|text: Asizdg s ttasbiḥ bac ad iṣfu wul, ukan aḥrrz s lḥamd bac ad as ittyafka mad ittcca
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d4|b0.0|text: Atnzzh n Llah subḥanahu wa taɛala zɣ kullu ma inqṣn: akkas n ma inqṣn (asizdg)
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d4|b0.1|text: Afulki n Llah f ukmmal n yiman nns d ṣṣifat nns (aḥrrz)
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d4|b0.1.1|text: S wul d yils, d ukayad iga ad d iffɣ zɣ wul
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d4|b0.2.1|text: S wul d yils d tfekka, d ukayad iga lxdmt
seal/makki/al-fatiha|d5|b0.1|text: S tiḥkayin d usmuttg n lxbar bac ad tjhd tussna
seal/hijra|title: Lhijra n nnbi s Lmadina (ɣ 53 n useggʷas)
seal/hijra|lines.0: Ayenna iḍrn: amuttg zɣ Makka s Lmadina lmunawwara
seal/hijra|lines.1: Tasnt n ubḍḍu: asnti n uzmz n Lmadina d uzmz ahijri (1 H)
seal/hijra|lines.2: Abddl: zɣ tsurft n ddɛwa d ṣṣbr s tsurft n ttamkin d ubnu n ddula
seal/hijra|lines.3: Amddakkʷl nns ɣ lhijra: Abu Bakr Ṣṣiddiq iṛḍa Rbbi fllas ﴿إِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحْزَنِ اِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ مَعَنَاۖ﴾
seal/hijra|lines.4: Abnu amzwaru: timzgida n Qubaʔ ukan timzgida n nnbi, d tagʷmat gr Lmuhajirin d Lʔanṣar
seal/madani|lines.0: Tiɣzi: 10 n iseggʷasn (zɣ 53 ar 63 n useggʷas n umud / 11 H = 632)
seal/madani|lines.2: Agbur agejdan: abnu n ddula d ccrɛ d lʔaḥkam n lfiqh
seal/madani|lines.3: Awal iggutn: «A yan d wid umnnin»
seal/madani|lines.4: Ṣṣifa tamatayt: afṣṣl n lmuɛamalat d lʔaḥkam d ubnu n tmetti tamslmt
seal/madani|lines.5: Ayenna iḍrn ugar: taɣzawt n Badr (2 H), taɣzawt n Uḥud (3 H), taɣzawt n Lʔaḥzab (5 H), ṣṣulḥ n Lḥudaybiya (6 H), lfatḥ n Makka (8 H), d lḥijja n lwadaɛ (10 H)
seal/madani/ghazawat|summary: Tiɣzawin lli ismktay Lqurʔan lkrim niɣ gisnt d ttazdarnt lʔayat nns; ar gisnt ittlmad umumn is nnṣr zɣ dar Llah ad iga, d is ṭṭaɛa d ubddad ad igan abrid nns.
seal/madani/ghazawat/badr|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ﴿وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ بِبَدْرٖ وَأَنتُمُۥٓ أَذِلَّةٞۖ﴾ (Al Ɛimran 123), gis d tazdar ssurt n Lʔanfal.
seal/madani/ghazawat/badr|lines.2: Ass n Lfurqan: amlilli amqqran amzwaru gr imslmn d imcrikn, ɣ inṣṛ Llah imuminn idrusn ﴿يَوْمَ اَ۬لْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ اَ۪لْتَقَى اَ۬لْجَمْعَٰنِۖ﴾ (Lʔanfal 41).
seal/madani/ghazawat/uhud|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: lʔayat zɣ ssurt n Al Ɛimran ﴿وَإِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنَ اَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّۓُ اُ۬لْمُومِنِينَ مَقَٰعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِۖ﴾ (Al Ɛimran 121).
seal/madani/ghazawat/uhud|lines.2: Almud: ṭṭaɛa n rrasul ﷺ d ssebba n nnṣr, d lbla ar issmyaz wid iṣdqn ﴿وَلِيَعْلَمَ اَ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ﴾ (Al Ɛimran 140).
seal/madani/ghazawat/bani-nadir|lines.0: Akud: aseggʷas wis kkuẓ n lhijra
seal/madani/ghazawat/bani-nadir|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ssurt n Lḥacr ﴿هُوَ اَ۬لذِےٓ أَخْرَجَ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ اَهْلِ اِ۬لْكِتَٰبِ مِن دِيٰ۪رِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ اِ۬لْحَشْرِۖ﴾ (Lḥacr 2).
seal/madani/ghazawat/bani-nadir|lines.2: Ssebba: rẓan lɛhd lli gr asn d nnbi ﷺ.
seal/madani/ghazawat/ahzab|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ssurt n Lʔaḥzab ﴿اِذْ جَآءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنَ اَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْۖ﴾ (Lʔaḥzab 10).
seal/madani/ghazawat/ahzab|lines.2: Abddad n imuminn: ɣzan lxandaq ɣ tama n Lmadina, nnan ﴿هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اَ۬للَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ﴾ (Lʔaḥzab 22).
seal/madani/ghazawat/fath|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ﴿إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ اُ۬للَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ﴾ (Nnaṣr 1).
seal/madani/ghazawat/fath|lines.2: Ayenna iḍrn: ikcm nnbi ﷺ s Makka iṛbḥ, iṣfa Lkaɛba zɣ ṣṣnam, isamḥ i ayt nns.
seal/madani/ghazawat/hunayn|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ﴿وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ اِذَ اَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنكُمْ شَئْاٗ﴾ (Ttawba 25).
seal/madani/ghazawat/hunayn|lines.2: Almud: nnṣr zɣ dar Llah ad iga, machi s tuggt n uṭṭun.
seal/madani/ghazawat/tabuk|lines.0: Akud: Rjab 9 H, tga taneggarut ɣ tɣzawin n nnbi ﷺ
seal/madani/ghazawat/tabuk|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ssurt n Ttawba ﴿اِ۬لذِينَ اَ۪تَّبَعُوهُ فِے سَاعَةِ اِ۬لْعُسْرَةِ﴾ (Ttawba 117), ɣmkan a as ttinin «Taɣzawt n tmara».
seal/madani/ghazawat/tabuk|lines.2: Almud: tuffɣa ɣ tmara, d usmyaz n wid iṣdqn d lmunafiqin.
seal/wafat|title: Lmut n nnbi ﷺ d usmmd n ddin (11 H / 63 n useggʷas)
seal/wafat|lines.2: Ayenna iḍrn: amun n nnbi ﷺ d Rrafiq Lʔaɛla
seal/wafat|lines.3: Asmmd n tuznt: taggara n lwaḥy d ubbi nns d usmmd n tɣufut («Ass-a kmmlɣ awn ddin nnun»)
ummah|title: Asmɣur n lumma d tira n tussniwin n ccrɛ
rashidun|subtitle: Azmz n lxulafaʔ rraciidin: lxilafa rraciida d umun n lmuṣḥaf
rashidun/caliph-1|title: Abu Bakr Ṣṣiddiq iṛḍa Rbbi fllas
rashidun/caliph-1|lines.0: Imgalln n rridda d umun amzwaru n Lqurʔan lkrim ɣ lmuṣḥaf.
rashidun/caliph-2|title: Ɛumar mmi-s n Lxaṭṭab iṛḍa Rbbi fllas
rashidun/caliph-2|lines.0: Lfutuḥat timqqranin, abnu n imdinn, asbdd n ddawawin d uzmz ahijri.
rashidun/caliph-3|title: Ɛutman mmi-s n Ɛaffan iṛḍa Rbbi fllas
rashidun/caliph-3|lines.0: Amun n lumma f yan lmuṣḥaf lmam (lmuṣḥaf alɛutmani) d tuzna nns s imuḍan akkʷ.
rashidun/caliph-4|title: Ɛli mmi-s n Abi Ṭalib iṛḍa Rbbi fllas
rashidun/caliph-4|lines.0: Asjhd n lqaḍaʔ d lfiqh n nnawazil ɣ lfitan.
rashidun/caliph-5|title: Lḥasan mmi-s n Ɛli iṛḍa Rbbi fllasn
rashidun/caliph-5|lines.0: Tiɣzi n lxilafa: iṭṭf tt ɣ tggira n lmut n baba-s Ɛli mmi-s n Abi Ṭalib iṛḍa Rbbi fllas s ccahada, tqqim ɣ ugʷns n sḍiṣ ayyurn ar sa.
rashidun/caliph-5|lines.1: Aseggʷas n Ljamaɛa: iǧǧa tt bac ad iḥḍu idammn n imslmn, ad imun awal n lumma (41 H).
ummah/umayyad|subtitle: Asnti n tira tunṣibt s ubrid
ummah/umayyad|summary: Iẓṛa uzmz Alʔumawi yan umuttg amqqran zɣ tira tafrdit imẓẓin s tira tunṣibt ittusnbbḍn ddaw tḥḍa n ddula tamslmt, acku tmɣur tmazirt, d bac ad ittuḥḍa ccrɛ.
ummah/umayyad/am-al-jamaa|lines.0: Tiɣzi n lxilafa n Lḥasan mmi-s n Ɛli iṛḍa Rbbi fllasn: iṭṭf tt ɣ tggira n lmut n baba-s Ɛli mmi-s n Abi Ṭalib iṛḍa Rbbi fllas s ccahada, tqqim ɣ ugʷns n sḍiṣ ayyurn ar sa.
ummah/umayyad/am-al-jamaa|lines.1: Ssebba d ma s iskr: iǧǧa Lḥasan iṛḍa Rbbi fllas lxilafa bac ad iḥḍu idammn n imslmn, ixs ad imun awal n lumma, ad kmmlnt iseggʷasn n tbḍḍa d umnaɣ.
ummah/umayyad/am-al-jamaa|lines.2: Lbcara n nnbi: inna nnbi ﷺ: «Mmi ad iga ssid, ahat Llah ad s issgad gr snat tqbilin timqqranin zɣ imslmn» (iwala t Lbuxari).
ummah/umayyad/am-al-jamaa|lines.3: Ssebba n yism: mmunn gis imslmn ddaw yat taɣda, bayɛan Muɛawiya mmi-s n Abi Sufyan iṛḍa Rbbi fllas, s ad tbda ddula talʔumawit.
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-1|title: Ssbab n umuttg s tira tunṣibt
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-1|lines.0: Lmut n imqqurn n lḥuffaḍ: tmɣur tmazirt n ddula, mmutn bahra n ṣṣaḥaba d imqqurn n ttabiɛin niɣ nɣan ɣ imgalln d tmizar, ar ttiggʷdn lɛulama ad iǧlu ulmud s lmut n wid t ittasin.
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-1|lines.1: Abayyn n lfitan d tskrkas: bdan imnaɣn d tiggayin, d urmmu n «uskar n lḥadit» (lḥadit n tskrkas), s ad iqqan ad ttyaran ssunna, ad ttusmuḍ, ad ttusmyaz.
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-2|lines.0: Lamr n Ɛumar mmi-s n Ɛbd Lɛaziz (immut 101 H): amzwaru n win yumrn s tira tunṣibt, yura i Abi Bakr mmi-s n Ḥazm d lwulat: «Ẓṛ ma illan zɣ lḥadit n rrasul n Llah ﷺ tarat, acku iggʷdɣ ad iǧlu ulmud ad ddun lɛulama».
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-2|lines.1: Lmam Ibn Cihab Zzuhri (immut 124 H): amzwaru n win yuran lḥadit s ubrid anṣib s lamr ad, ismun ssunan d lʔatar ɣ idlisn lli ttusnɣlnin s ddula, tuzn tn s tmizar.
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-2|lines.2: Ṣṣifa n tira talʔumawit: amun amata ismunn kullu; ttyaranin lʔaḥadit lmarfuɛa ttumyaxlaḍnt d lfatawi n ṣṣaḥaba d wawal n ttabiɛin, bla asmmas iqqan niɣ abḍḍu s isntal gr tiwwura n tussna.
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-3|lines.0: Tinqqiḍin n liɛrab: asbdd n tggira n wawalen s tnqqiḍin s ufus n Abi Lʔaswad Dduʔali (immut 69 H).
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-3|lines.1: Tinqqiḍin n liɛjam: asmyaz n isekkilen ittmcabahn s tnqqiḍin ɣ uzmz n Ɛbd Lmalik mmi-s n Marwan, s ufus n Naṣr mmi-s n Ɛaṣim d Yaḥya mmi-s n Yaɛmar.
ummah/abbasid|subtitle: Azmz n uwrɣ n tira d usmmas s tiwwura
ummah/abbasid|summary: Azmz Alɛabbasi iga tiɣmirt n tmmaḍ d tfulki n tussna; ɣ mmuttgnt tussniwin zɣ idlisn n umun amata s tussniwin ttmyaznin, ittuzdgnin, ttusmmasnin s tiwwura s ibrdan n tussna iqqanin.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-1|title: Amyaz n tussniwin d ubrid n usmmas s tiwwura
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-1|lines.0: Abḍḍu n tussniwin d tzlayt: tmyaz tussna n lḥadit d lfiqh, d tussna n ttafsir s yiman nns, d llant tussniwin n lala i tnmmalt n uḍris n ccrɛ.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-1|lines.1: Amuttg zɣ umun s usmmas s tiwwura: asmmas n lktub f tiwwura n lfiqh s isntal (lktab n ṭṭhara, tẓallit, lbuyuɛ...) niɣ f lmasanid n irgazn.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-2|title: Tira n kkuẓ lmaḍahib n lfiqh timqqranin
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-2|lines.0: Lmaḍhab alḥanafi: tira n lfiqh n Abi Ḥanifa Nnuɛman (immut 150 H) s lktub n inlmadn nns, ugar «Ḍahir rriwaya» n Muḥammad mmi-s n Lḥasan Ccaybani.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-2|lines.1: Lmaḍhab almaliki: tira n Malik mmi-s n Anas (immut 179 H) i lktab nns «Lmuwaṭṭaʔ», ismun gr lḥadit d lfiqh d lxdmt n ayt Lmadina.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-2|lines.2: Lmaḍhab accafiɛi: tira n Muḥammad mmi-s n Idris Ccafiɛi (immut 204 H) i lktab «Lʔumm» ɣ lfiqh, d lktab «Rrisala» (amzwaru n lktab lli d aɣ ilkmn ɣ uṣul lfiqh).
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-2|lines.3: Lmaḍhab alḥanbali: tira n lfiqh n Aḥmad mmi-s n Ḥanbal (immut 241 H) s inlmadn nns, d lmawsuɛa nns tamqqrant n lḥadit «Musnad Lmam Aḥmad».
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-3|title: Tankra n usmuḍ n lḥadit d sḍiṣ lktub ṣṣiḥaḥ
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-3|lines.0: Ṣṣaḥiḥan: tira n «Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari» (immut 256 H) d «Ṣaḥiḥ Muslim» n unlmad nns (immut 261 H); gan lktub ugar iṣḥḥan ɣ tggira n Lqurʔan, s lmizan ugar iqqann n lisnad d usswingm.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-3|lines.1: Kkuẓ ssunan: Sunan Abi Dawud, Ttirmiḍi, Nnasaʔi, d Ibn Maja, s ad kmmlnt sḍiṣ lktub ittusnadnin.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-4|title: Tussniwin n lala lli ittxdamn aḍris n Lqurʔan d lḥadit
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-4|lines.0: Nnaḥw d tutlayt: tafulki n snat tinmlin n Lbaṣra d Lkufa d tira n ilugan (zund «Lktab» n Sibawayh) bac ad ittuḥḍa yils aɛrab d ufham iṣḥan.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-4|lines.1: Ttafsir amawsuɛi: tira n Lmam Ibn Jarir Ṭṭabari (immut 310 H) i lktab nns «Jamiɛ lbayan ɛan taʔwil ay Lqurʔan», d amzwaru n lmarajiɛ n ttafsir.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-4|lines.2: Tussna n uṣul lfiqh: abddad n ilugan imqqurn n usufɣ n lʔaḥkam zɣ tmatarin nsn.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-4|lines.3: Tussna n rrijal d ljarḥ d ttaɛdil: abayyn n allal n usmuḍ bac ad ttyasan lɛadala d ubddad n imsiwln, ad ttuḥḍa ssunna zɣ ma gis ikcmn.
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams|title: Imam n lḥadit n nnbi d ṣṣiḥaḥ d ssunan (lqrn wis 3 H)
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/bukhari|lines: Isem d udɣar: Muḥammad mmi-s n Ismaɛil Lbuxari, ilul ɣ Buxara, inkkr ɣ timdinin n umaḍal aslmn ar ismun ar isnqqay ssunna.
Lktab amqqran: «Ljamiɛ lmusnad ṣṣaḥiḥ lmuxtaṣar min umur rasul Llah ﷺ wa sunanih wa ayyamih» (Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari).
Lktab ugar iṣḥḥan ɣ tggira n lktab n Llah taɛala, s umsasa n lɛulama n lumma.
Ittrar tiskfal ugar ifulkin n ṣṣḥt: tuqqna n ssnad, lɛadala n imsiwln d ubddad nnsn ikmmln, asbdd n umlilli d tilin ɣ yan uzmz, d tnjjit zɣ ccuḍuḍ d lɛilla.
Ittusan s lfiqh n izwal n tiwwura nns iqqanin, ar ttinin: «Lfiqh n Lbuxari ɣ izwal n tiwwura nns a illa».
Lktub yaḍnin: «Lʔadab lmufrad», «Ttarix lkabir», d «Xalq afɛal lɛibad».
Isem d udɣar: Muslim mmi-s n Lḥajjaj Lqucayri Nnaysaburi, anlmad n Lbuxari d yan zɣ imam n lḥuffaḍ.
Lktab amqqran: «Lmusnad ṣṣaḥiḥ lmuxtaṣar bi naql lɛadl ɛan lɛadl ila rasul Llah ﷺ» (Ṣaḥiḥ Muslim).
Gʷma-s n Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari d wis sin ɣ lktub ugar iṣḥḥan ɣ tggira n Lqurʔan lkrim.
Ittmyaz s ufulki n usmmas d tira; ar ismun ibrdan n lḥadit d wawal nns ɣ yan udɣar bla abḍḍu, bac ad isshl ufham n rriwaya d lfiqh nns.
Isbdu lktab nns s yat tmzwarut n ubrid ur ilin tamtilt, tga zɣ ilugan ugar iqdimn d ugar iqqann ɣ tussna n mṣṭalaḥ lḥadit d usmuḍ n lisnad.
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/abu-dawud|sub: Lmam n ssunan d lfiqh n lʔaḥkam
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/abu-dawud|lin: Isem d tmẓi: Sulayman mmi-s n Lʔacɛat Ssijistani, anlmad n Lmam Aḥmad mmi-s n Ḥanbal, inkkr ɣ tmizar, izdɣ ɣ Lbaṣra.
Lktab amqqran: «Sunan Abi Dawud» (ismun ɣ ugʷns n 5,274 n lḥadit).
Aṭṭaf n lfuqahaʔ d lmujtahidin ɣ usufɣ n lʔaḥkam; ixṣṣa amun n lʔaḥadit n lʔaḥkam n lfiqh d lḥlal d lḥram, ur ismun lmawaɛiḍ d tḥkayin.
Ibayyn tasga n lʔaḥadit: ma gis illan lwahn ijhdn ibayyn t, ma fllas isusm iṣlḥ i lḥujja d lʔiɛtibar.
Inna fllas Lxaṭṭabi: «Lktab n Ssunan n Abi Dawud iga lktab ccrif; ur ittyara ɣ tussna n ddin yan lktab irwas as».
Lktub yaḍnin: «Risalat Abi Dawud ila ahl Makka», d «Nnasix wa lmansux», d «Lmarasil».
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/tirmidhi|subt: Bab n ssunan d lfiqh n lḥadit
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/tirmidhi|line: Isem d tmẓi: Muḥammad mmi-s n Ɛisa mmi-s n Sawra Ttirmiḍi, anlmad n Lbuxari amqqran, ilul imɣur ɣ Tirmiḍ ɣ tmizar n Ma waraʔ nnahr.
Ismun gr lḥadit d lfiqh n ṣṣaḥaba d ttabiɛin d lfuqahaʔ n tmizar (Abu Ḥanifa, Malik, Ccafiɛi, d Aḥmad), ar ibayyan win iṭṭfn s lḥadit d win t iǧǧan.
Amzwaru n usbdd n tiskfal n lḥadit d imsmyaḍ nns; amzwaru n win issnmalan asmmas: (ṣaḥiḥ, ḥasan, ɣarib, ḥasan ṣaḥiḥ).
Ilmmaḍ s ubayyn n lɛilal n lʔaḥadit d ismawn n imsiwln d lkuna nnsn s tɣara ifulkin bahra.
Lktub yaḍnin: «Ccamaʔil lmuḥammadiya» (lktab ugar imqqurn d ugar ittusnan ɣ ṣṣifat n nnbi ﷺ d lʔaxlaq nns), d «Lɛilal lkabir».
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/nasai|lines.0: Isem d tmẓi: Aḥmad mmi-s n Cuɛayb mmi-s n Ɛli Nnasaʔi, s «Nasa» ɣ Xurasan, imuddu ɣ utrr n lḥadit s Lḥijaz d Lɛiraq d Ccam d Maṣr, izdɣ ɣ Maṣr.
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/nasai|lines.1: Lktab amqqran: «Ssunan ṣṣuɣra» lli ttinin «Lmujtaba» (Sunan Nnasaʔi), isti tt zɣ lktab nns «Ssunan lkubra».
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/nasai|lines.3: Ittḥḍḍa bahra ɣ irgazn; tiwtilin nns gant zɣ tid ugar iqqanin ɣ ayt ssunan, d lktab nns ugar n ssunan ɣ tggira n Ṣṣaḥiḥayn ur gis llin bahra lʔaḥadit iḍɛfn.
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/nasai|lines.4: Ilmmaḍ s tɣara ɣ lɛilal n lʔaḥadit d umxalaf n wawal n imsiwln d ibrdan nnsn.
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/nasai|lines.5: Lktub yaḍnin: «Ssunan lkubra», d «Ḍḍuɛafaʔ wa lmatrukun», d «Ɛamal lyawm wa llayla».
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/ibn-majah|sub: Win issmdn sḍiṣ lktub, bab n usmmas ifulkin s tiwwura
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/ibn-majah|lin: Isem d tmẓi: Muḥammad mmi-s n Yazid Rrabaɛi Lqazwini, ilul ɣ Qazwin, imuddu s Lɛiraq d Ccam d Lḥijaz d Maṣr ɣ utrr n lḥadit.
Lktab amqqran: «Sunan Ibn Maja» (lktab wis sḍiṣ ittusnadn ɣ ssunan).
Ittmyaz s ufulki n usmmas d tɣara n tiwwura d tsɣart n usatal n lfiqh (4,341 n lḥadit ttubḍḍanin f 32 n lktab d 1500 n tggurt).
Ittusan s «Zawaʔid Ibn Maja»: iwala waḥdut ɣ ugʷns n 1339 n lḥadit ur d ssufɣn ayt smmus lktub izwarn, gisn ṣṣaḥiḥ d lḥasan d ḍḍaɛif.
Bddn ugar n imam n lḥadit (zɣ uzmz n Ibn Ṭahir Lmaqdisi) f is iga wis sḍiṣ ɣ sḍiṣ lktub, s lfwayd nns d zzawaʔid nns ur ilin tamtilt.
Lktub yaḍnin: «Tafsir Ibn Maja» (iǧla), d «Tarix Qazwin».
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams|title: Imqqurn n ttafsir d lmawsuɛat n ubayyn n Lqurʔan
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/tabari|subtit: Ccix n lmufassirin d lmam n lmuʔarrixin
Adɣar d lmqam: Muḥammad mmi-s n Jarir Ṭṭabari, lmam mujtahid ismun gr tussniwin n ttafsir d lḥadit d lfiqh d lqiraʔat d ttarix.
Lktab amqqran ɣ ttafsir: «Jamiɛ lbayan ɛan taʔwil ay Lqurʔan» (Tafsir Ṭṭabari).
Aṭṭaf amzwaru ɣ ttafsir s lmaʔtur d lktab ugar imqqurn ɣ lktub n ttafsir akkʷ.
Ar d issaɣ laya, ukan ar d issaɣ rriwayat s ssnad zɣ nnbi ﷺ d ṣṣaḥaba d ttabiɛin, ar issmsasa lʔasanid ar isti gr wawalen.
Asmrs iqqan n tussniwin n taɛrabt, nnaḥw, d ccawahid n ccɛr, d ubayyn n lqiraʔat n Lqurʔan d lfiqh n lʔaḥkam.
Lktab n ttarix: «Tarix rrusul wa lmuluk» (Tarix Ṭṭabari), lmarjiɛ amqqran ɣ ttarix n tuznin d lumma.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/zamakhshari|s: Bab n «Lkaccaf» ɣ lbalaɣa n Lqurʔan
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/zamakhshari|l: Isem d llqb: Maḥmud mmi-s n Ɛumar Zzamaxcari, ttinin as «Jar Llah» acku izdɣ bahra ɣ tama n Makka lmukarrama.
Lktab amqqran: «Lkaccaf ɛan ḥaqaʔiq ɣawamiḍ ttanzil wa ɛuyun lʔaqawil fi wujuh ttaʔwil».
Zɣ lktub ugar ittusnan ɣ ttafsir n lbalaɣa d lbayan; ikccf lʔasrar n nnaḍm n Lqurʔan d tɣawsiwin iqqann n liɛjaz d tussniwin n lmaɛani d lbayan.
Asmrs n uɣaras n usqsi d tririt («Iɣ tnnit... nniɣ...») bac ad ittuqllab ɣ wudmawn n lmɛna, ad d ittusufɣ ma gis ifulkin.
Wakkʷa lʔiɛtizal nns ɣ lɛaqida lli fllas nbbhn lɛulama, iqqim lktab nns d lmarjiɛ ur gis izzgir ḥtta yan lmufassir ɣ ufham n lʔasrar n lfaṣaḥa d liɛrab.
Lktub yaḍnin: «Asas lbalaɣa», d «Lmufaṣṣal fi ɛilm lɛarabiya», d «Lfaʔiq fi ɣarib lḥadit».
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.0: Isem d lmqam: Muḥammad mmi-s n Ɛumar mmi-s n Lḥusayn Rrazi, ttinin as «Ibn Xaṭib Rrayy» d «Lmam», ismun gr nnql d lɛql d uṣul ddin.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.1: Lktab amqqran: «Mafatiḥ lɣayb» (Ttafsir lkabir) ɣ 32 n tsdlist.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.3: Ilmmaḍ bahra s tussna n «lmunasabat» gr lʔayat d ssur, d ubayyn n umsasa n ugbur n Lqurʔan lkrim.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.4: Lmawsuɛa n lɛql tmɣurt; izayd ɣ ufṣṣl n tussniwin n ddunit d tmatarin n ttawḥid s lɛql.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.5: Irar gis f lfalasifa d lmuɛtazila, d usswingm iqqan n tiɣawsiwin n luṣul d lfiqh.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.6: Lktub yaḍnin: «Lmaḥṣul fi ɛilm uṣul lfiqh», d «Asas ttaqdis», d «Lmaṭalib lɛaliya».
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/qurtubi|subti: Ccix n ttafsir n lfiqh d usufɣ n lʔaḥkam
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/qurtubi|lines: Isem d tmẓi: Muḥammad mmi-s n Aḥmad Lʔanṣari Lqurṭubi, ilul ɣ Qurṭuba ɣ Landalus, ukan imuddu s Maṣr, izdɣ gis, immut ɣ Lminya.
Lktab amqqran: «Ljamiɛ li aḥkam Lqurʔan wa lmubayyin lima taḍammanahu min ssunna wa ay lfurqan».
Lmawsuɛa ugar imqqurn d ugar ismunn ɣ ttafsir n lfiqh ɣ ttarix n Lislam; ismun lʔayat n lʔaḥkam ifṣṣl tiɣawsiwin nnsnt s tɣara.
Lɛadl ɣ tussna d uḍfar n tmatart; wakkʷa iga amaliki, ar ittḍfar tamatart ugar ijhdn ar tt iṣṛṛ bla taɛaṣṣubt i lmaḍhab.
Ismun bahra n tussniwin: tutlayin, nnaḥw, lqiraʔat, nnasix d lmansux, d tririt f wid ibddɛn.
Lktub yaḍnin: «Ttaḍkira bi aḥwal lmawta wa umur laxira», d «Lʔasna fi carḥ asmaʔ Llah lḥusna».
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/ibn-kathir|su: Aṭṭaf n ttafsir s lmaʔtur d usmuḍ n rriwayat
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/ibn-kathir|li: Isem d lmqam: Ismaɛil mmi-s n Ɛumar mmi-s n Katir Lqurayci Ddimacqi, anlmad n Ibn Taymiya d Lmizzi, d yan zɣ imqqurn n lḥuffaḍ d lmuʔarrixin.
Lktab amqqran: «Tafsir Lqurʔan lɛaḍim» (Tafsir Ibn Katir).

Amdya ugar ikmmln n ulugan: «Abrid ugar iṣḥḥan ɣ ttafsir: ad ittufssr Lqurʔan s Lqurʔan; ma ittusmmun ɣ yan udɣar ittufṣṣl ɣ wayyaḍ, iɣ ur t tufit ar tddut s ssunna, ukan s wawal n ṣṣaḥaba, ukan ttabiɛin».
Asmuḍ iqqan n lʔasanid, d usmyaz n ṣṣaḥiḥ d ḍḍaɛif s lḥukm nns zund lḥafiḍ inmmlan.
Yan umussu amzwaru ittusnbbḍn ɣ usbḍl n «lʔisraʔiliyat» d uḥḍḍar zɣ tiɣawsiwin nnsnt iɣrbn d tḥkayin nnsnt ur ṣḥḥanin ɣ tḥkayin n lanbiya d igdudn izrin.
Lktub yaḍnin: «Lbidaya wa nnihaya» (lmawsuɛa n ttarix ugar imqqurn n lumma), d «Jamiɛ lmasanid wa ssunan», d «Ṭabaqat ccafiɛiya».
ummah/mamluk|subtitle: Azmz n lmawsuɛat d ccuruḥ imqqurn n lḥadit
ummah/mamluk|summary: Azmz n Lmamalik iga tiɣmirt n tira n lmawsuɛat d ccuruḥ n ssunna n nnbi; ɣ ttfrrɣn lɛulama i umun n ma ibḍḍan zɣ tussniwin d uḥḍu n ttrat aslmn ɣ tggira n tmara n uḍuḍ n Baɣdad:
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-1|title: Amussu n ccuruḥ imqqurn n lḥadit
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-1|lines.0: Tḥḍa ikmmln s Ljamiɛ ṣṣaḥiḥ n Lbuxari d Ṣaḥiḥ Muslim d ssunan, d usswingm n tiɣawsiwin iqqann n lisnad d tutlayt d lfiqh n lʔaḥkam.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-1|lines.1: Abayyn n «Fatḥ lbari» n Ibn Ḥajar zund ccrḥ ugar imqqurn n lḥadit, d «Ɛumdat lqari» n Lɛayni, d «Carḥ Nnawawi ɛala Muslim».
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-2|title: Tafulki n tussniwin n mṣṭalaḥ lḥadit d rrijal
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-2|lines.0: Asswingm n tussniwin n lḥadit d ubddad n ilugan n lmuṣṭalaḥ s ubnu f «Muqaddimat Ibn Ṣṣalaḥ» (Alfiyat Lɛiraqi, d Nuxbat lfikr n Ibn Ḥajar).
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-2|lines.1: Asmɣur ɣ tira n tudrt n imsiwln d ṭṭabaqat d ttarix (Tahḍib lkamal n Lmizzi, d Siyar aɛlam nnubalaʔ n Ḍḍahabi).
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-3|lines.0: Tira n lmawsuɛat ismunn ɣ ttafsir d tussniwin n Lqurʔan (Lburhan n Zzarkaci, d Litqan n Ssuyuṭi).
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-3|lines.1: Aḥḍu n yils aɛrab d tira n imawaln imqqurn zund «Lisan lɛarab» n Ibn Manḍur.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|subtitl: Win issdrn ssunna, ccix n lmuḥadditin d lfuqahaʔ
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.0: Isem d tmẓi: Yaḥya mmi-s n Caraf Nnawawi, ilul ɣ Nawa ɣ Ḥawran ɣ Ccam, izdɣ ɣ Dimacq, lmam n zzuhd d usswingm n lfiqh d lḥadit.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.1: Lktab amqqran ɣ ccrḥ n lḥadit: «Lminhaj carḥ Ṣaḥiḥ Muslim ibn Lḥajjaj» (Carḥ Nnawawi ɛala Muslim).
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.3: Ccrḥ ammas ismunn, ɣ isswingm lfiqh n lḥadit s tɣara, ar ibayyan lmaḍahib n lɛulama d lfwayd n lʔasanid, d umxalaf n wawal n imsiwln d tutlayin nnsn.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.4: Iskr izwal i tiwwura n Ṣaḥiḥ Muslim lli ur as iga Muslim izwal ibaynn, ar gan izwal n Nnawawi a ttusnadnin dar ccurraḥ.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.5: Ismun gr tɣara n lḥadit d usswingm n lfiqh s umsasa gr lmaḍahib, s yan uɣaras ifulkin isshlan.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.6: Lktub yaḍnin imqqurn: «Riyaḍ ṣṣaliḥin» (lktab n lḥadit ugar ittwaẓnn ɣ umaḍal aslmn), «Lʔarbaɛun nnawawiya», «Lmajmuɛ carḥ Lmuhaḍḍab» (lmawsuɛa n lfiqh s umsasa ugar imqqurn), d «Tahḍib lʔasmaʔ wa lluɣat».
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/dhahabi|subtit: Lmam n lmuḥadditin d lmuʔarrix n Lislam
Isem d lmqam: Muḥammad mmi-s n Aḥmad mmi-s n Ɛutman Ḍḍahabi Ddimacqi, lmuḥaddit n uzmz nns, inmmlan ɣ lɛilal n lḥadit d usmuḍ n irgazn d ttawtiq.
Lktub imqqurn ɣ tudrt n mddn d rrijal d ttarix:
«Siyar aɛlam nnubalaʔ»: lmawsuɛa ugar imqqurn d ugar ifulkin ɣ tudrt n imqqurn d lɛulama d lxulafaʔ d ayt zzuhd ɣ lqrun, ɣ 25 n tsdlist.
«Tarix Lislam wa wafayat lmacahir wa lʔaɛlam»: ttarix n lumma tamslmt aseggʷas s useggʷas ar aseggʷas n 700 H.
«Mizan lʔiɛtidal fi naqd rrijal»: lmizan n usmuḍ n imsiwln d ubayyn n wid iḍɛfn d wid ittyaǧǧan, d ukkas n tuhmt f wid ittyamann.
Lktub ɣ tussniwin n Lqurʔan d lḥadit: «Maɛrifat lqurraʔ lkibar ɛala ṭṭabaqat wa lʔaɛṣar», d «Lmuqiḍa fi ɛilm muṣṭalaḥ lḥadit».
Abrid: tidt ikmmln, lɛadl iqqan ɣ tudrt n imnaɣn d wid immsasan, d wawal isfuln ikccmn ɣ usmuḍ n rriwayat d lxbar.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ibn-hajar|subt: Amir lmuʔminin ɣ lḥadit d aneggaru n lḥuffaḍ
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ibn-hajar|line: Isem d lmqam: Aḥmad mmi-s n Ɛli mmi-s n Ḥajar Lɛasqalani Lkinani, qaḍi lquḍat ɣ Maṣr d ccix n Lislam ɣ uzmz nns.
Lktab amqqran: «Fatḥ lbari bi carḥ Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari» (tira nns d usɣrd nns ṭṭfn 25 n useggʷas, ttinin fllas: «Ur tlli lhijra ɣ tggira n Lfatḥ»).
Tiɣmirt n ccuruḥ n lḥadit n nnbi akkʷ; ifsi tiɣawsiwin iwɛrn ɣ Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari, iqqn lmuɛallaqat nns, ismun ibrdan akkʷ n lḥadit d wawal nns zɣ ugensu n lktub n ssunna.
Isufɣ ifḍan n lfwayd n lfiqh d luṣul d tutlayt, ismuḍ lʔasanid s lmizan ugar iqqann n lḥadit.
Isbdu t s yat tmzwarut tamqqrant «Hady ssari», ɣ ifṣṣl ilugan n Ljamiɛ ṣṣaḥiḥ d izwal nns, irar ccubuhat f irgazn nns.

Lktub n lḥadit d lmuṣṭalaḥ: «Nuxbat lfikr fi muṣṭalaḥ ahl lʔatar» d ccrḥ nns «Nuzhat nnaḍar» (tira ugar iqqann n ilugan n lmuṣṭalaḥ), «Tahḍib ttahḍib», «Taqrib ttahḍib», d «Buluɣ lmaram min adillat lʔaḥkam».
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|subtitle: Qaḍi lquḍat d lmawsuɛa n ccrḥ n Lbuxari
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.0: Isem d tmẓi: Maḥmud mmi-s n Aḥmad Lɛayni Lḥanafi, ilul ɣ Ɛayn Tab ɣ Ḥalab, imuddu s Dimacq d Lqahira, iṭṭf lqaḍaʔ n lḥanafiya d lḥisba.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.1: Lktab amqqran: «Ɛumdat lqari fi carḥ Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari» ɣ ugʷns n 25 n tsdlist.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.3: Lmawsuɛa tamqqrant n tutlayt d liɛrab d lfiqh; s a immnaɣ d lḥafiḍ Ibn Ḥajar lli dids illan ɣ yan uzmz, mmun ɣ wakud n tira.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.4: Abrid ur ilin tamtilt ɣ usmmas n ccrḥ: ar ibḍḍu ccrḥ n kraygatt lḥadit s ifrdisn ittusbadun: (abayyn n irgazn nns, abayyn n tutlayin nns, liɛrab nns, asufɣ n lmaɛani d lbayan, ukan asufɣ n lʔaḥkam n lfiqh d lmaḍahib n imam d nnṣr n lfiqh alḥanafi s tmatart nns).
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.5: Asmɣur amqqran ɣ tiɣawsiwin n nnaḥw d ṣṣarf d ubddad n wawalen iɣrbn d ttarix n imqqurn.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.6: Lktub yaḍnin: «Carḥ Sunan Abi Dawud», «Maɣani lʔaxyar fi rijal maɛani lʔatar», d «Ɛiqd ljuman fi tarix ahl zzaman».
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|subtitl: Aneggaru n ayt lmawsuɛat d bab n umun n ttrat
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.0: Isem d lmqam: Ɛbd Rraḥman mmi-s n Abi Bakr Ssuyuṭi, lmam amawsuɛi lkmnt lktub nns ɣ ugʷns n 600 n lktab ɣ tussniwin akkʷ.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.1: Lktub imqqurn ɣ ttafsir d tussniwin n Lqurʔan:
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.2: «Litqan fi ɛulum Lqurʔan»: lmarjiɛ amawsuɛi ugar imqqurn ɣ tussniwin n Lqurʔan ɣ ttarix, isnbbḍ gis 80 n wanaw zɣ tussniwin n lwaḥy.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.3: «Ddurr lmantur fi ttafsir bi lmaʔtur»: amun ugar imqqurn n lʔaḥadit d lʔatar n nnbi d ṣṣaḥaba ɣ ttafsir n lʔayat n Lqurʔan lkrim.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.4: «Tafsir Ljalalayn»: s a ismmd ttafsir n Jalal Ddin Lmaḥalli, iga ttafsir ugar ittusnan imẓẓin isshlan lli ttɣran mddn.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.5: Ljhd ɣ ccuruḥ n lḥadit d ssunna:
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.6: «Tadrib rrawi fi carḥ Taqrib Nnawawi»: aṭṭaf n tussna n lmuṣṭalaḥ, d ccrḥ n Sunan Nnasaʔi d Ibn Maja, d lktab nns ismunn «Ljamiɛ ṣṣaɣir».
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.7: Abrid: azzrb ɣ umun, tɣara ɣ usmmas d tira, d uḥḍu n iḍrisn n lmaxṭuṭat lli iǧlan i lumma.
ummah/ottoman|subtitle: Tḥḍa n lmuṣḥaf d ubddad n lmaḍahib
ummah/ottoman|summary: Iẓṛa uzmz Alɛutmani yat tsurft tamqqrant n ubddad n ccrɛ d tsgiwin, ittmyazn s tḥḍa n lmuṣḥaf ccrif d usnbbḍ n lfiqh s ilugan d usmmd n ccuruḥ:
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-1|title: Taẓuri n tira n lmuṣḥaf ccrif d lxaṭṭ aɛrab
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-1|lines.0: Tlkm tira n lmṣaḥf tiɣmirt n tɣara d tifawt ɣ Isṭanbul s ufus n imqqurn n ixṭṭaṭn n lmṣaḥf (Lḥafiḍ Ɛutman, Aḥmad Qara Ḥiṣari).
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-1|lines.1: Ar d iffɣ wawal n ttarix: «Iḍr Lqurʔan ɣ Makka, ittuɣra ɣ Maṣr, ittyara ɣ Isṭanbul».
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-2|title: Abddad n lmaḍhab alḥanafi d usnbbḍ amaynu s ilugan
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-2|lines.0: Asnad n lfiqh alḥanafi d lmaḍhab anṣib n lqaḍaʔ d ddula ɣ tmizar akkʷ.
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-2|lines.1: Tira n «Majallat lʔaḥkam lɛadliya» zund tira tamzwarut tamaynut n lfiqh aslmn s ilugan, ɣ talɣa n ifrdisn n lqanun ismunn.
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-3|title: Ccuruḥ imqqurn d lḥawaci n ttafsir d lḥadit
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-3|lines.0: Tafulki n lḥawaci ittuswingmn i lktub n imam izrin (Ḥaciyat Ibn Ɛabidin ɣ lfiqh, d Ḥaciyat Ljamal ɛala Ljalalayn ɣ ttafsir).
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-3|lines.1: Abayyn n lmawsuɛat n ttafsir ismunn zund «Ruḥ lmaɛani» n Lʔalusi, d lktub n umun n lqiraʔat d ubddad n ttajwid.
rashidun/caliph-1|lines.1: Amun n Lqurʔan lkrim: tira nns ɣ ṣṣuḥuf yat, lʔayat nns ttusmmasnt; iṭṭf t Zayd mmi-s n Tabit iṛḍa Rbbi fllas, ɣ tggira n ccahada n kigan zɣ lqurraʔ ɣ umgli n Lyamama; amun n uḥḍḍar, acku ttiggʷdn ad iǧlu kra zɣ Lqurʔan s lmut n wid t ittasin, ur iga amun n lqiraʔat ɣ yat.
seal/ulum-al-quran/makki-madani|lines.0: Amakki dar ugar n lɛulama: ma d iḍrn dat lhijra, wakkʷa iḍr bṛṛa i Makka.
seal/ulum-al-quran|summary: Tiɣawsiwin d iẓuran imqqurn ismun yan ummas: Lqurʔan lkrim; bdan d tzdart nns, ur ittyafham Lqurʔan s ufham n tidt abla s nttni.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-qiraat|lines.0: Ibn Ljazari: aneggaru n lmuḥaqqiqin ɣ lqiraʔat, iffɣ d ɣ tggira n Ibn Mujahid s lqrun.
rashidun/caliph-1|lines.2: Qqimnt ṣṣuḥuf dar Abu Bakr, ukan dar Ɛumar, ukan dar Ḥafṣa iṛḍa Rbbi fllasn; ttyusmmant «Lmuṣḥaf».
seal/ulum-al-quran/asbab-nuzul|lines.0: Ssebba n nnuzul: ayenna iḍrn niɣ asqsi lli f d tḍr laya, iɣ ibdd.
seal/ulum-al-quran/asbab-nuzul|lines.1: Alugan ittusnan: lɛibra s tmatayt n wawal, machi s tzlayt n ssebba; lḥukm iga amatay i kullu ma irwasn ayenna iḍrn.
seal/ulum-al-quran/ahruf-qiraat|lines.7: Alugan n lqiraʔa lli ittyaqbaln: kraygatt lqiraʔa immsasan d taɛrabt wakkʷa s yan wudm, immsasan d tira n yan zɣ lmṣaḥf wakkʷa s lʔiḥtimal, d ssnad nns mutawatir.
ummah/present|lines.0: Lktub imaynutn ɣ tussniwin n Lqurʔan: «Manahil lɛirfan fi ɛulum Lqurʔan» n Zzurqani, d «Mabaḥit fi ɛulum Lqurʔan» n Ṣubḥi Ṣṣaliḥ, d «Mabaḥit fi ɛulum Lqurʔan» n Mannaɛ Lqaṭṭan, d «Itqan lburhan fi ɛulum Lqurʔan» n Faḍl Ḥasan Ɛabbas, d «Nnabaʔ lɛaḍim» n Muḥammad Ɛbd Llah Darraz.
seal/ulum-al-quran|subtitle: Tazdart nns, amakki d umadani nns, ssbab n nnuzul nns, nnasix d lmansux nns, lʔaḥruf d lqiraʔat nns
seal/ulum-al-quran/nuzul|lines.6: Zɣ lḥikma n tzdart nns imik s imik: asjhd n wul n nnbi ﷺ, d usmuttg imik s imik ɣ tarbit.
seal/ulum-al-quran/makki-madani|lines.3: Zɣ lfwayd n tussna nns: afham n usatal n wawal d tsurfin n ddɛwa, tussna n nnasix d lmansux (ma d iḍrn ɣ tggira ar isnsax ma t izwarn), tussna n ttarix n ccrɛ d usmuttg nns imik s imik, lɛawn nns ɣ ttafsir, d usufɣ n ssira n rrasul ﷺ.
seal/ulum-al-quran/naskh|lines.0: Nnasx ɣ tutlayt: akkas, d ar ittili s lmɛna n ubddl d umuttg.
seal/ulum-al-quran/nuzul|lines.4: Amzwaru n ma d iḍrn: asnti n ssurt n Lɛalaq ﴿اَ۪قْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ اَ۬لذِے خَلَقَۖ﴾, ɣ wawal ugar iṣḥḥan.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-qiraat|lines.3: Ccaṭibi (immut 590 H): inḍm sa n lqiraʔat ɣ tmnḍumt nns «Ḥirz lʔamani wa wajh ttahani», lli ittusnan s «Ccaṭibiya».
seal/ulum-al-quran/ahruf-qiraat|lines.1: Lʔaḥruf ssabɛa: sa n wudmawn ifṣṣḥn zɣ tutlayin n waɛrabn, s ad iḍr Lqurʔan bac ad isshl i lumma.
seal/ulum-al-quran/naskh|lines.3: Amdya: lwajib n tbdd n yiḍ ɣ usnti n ssurt n Lmuzzammil, ittukkas s wawal n Llah taɛala ﴿فَاقْرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ اَ۬لْقُرْءَانِۖ﴾.
seal/makki|lines.5: Ṣṣifat iggutn ɣ ssur timakkiyin: ar gisnt ttaggʷtnt «Kalla» d «Bal» d «Bala», ar gisnt llant ssajadat, ar bddant s isekkilen ibḍḍan (abla ssurt n Lbaqara d Al Ɛimran), ar gisnt llant tḥkayin n lanbiya d igdudn izrin (abla ssurt n Lbaqara d Al Ɛimran), ar ttmmaggarnt tiɣawsiwin n lɛaqida iṣḥan lli d iwin lanbiya akkʷ, ur gisnt llin lʔaḥkam n ccrɛ
seal/ulum-al-quran/ahruf-qiraat|lines.4: Rrawi: win d iwwin lqiraʔa n lmam zɣ ɣurs.
seal/ulum-al-quran/makki-madani|lines.2: Asbadu ad s wakud ad igan wa ugar ijhdn: alugan ismunn kullu ur ittbddaln, ar ittkkas ugar n umxalaf, iqrrb s ufham n ṣṣaḥaba.
seal/ulum-al-quran/ahruf-qiraat|lines.2: Lʔaḥruf ssabɛa d lqiraʔat: tlla gr asn tmlalt, walaynni ur gin yat; sa n lqiraʔat ur gant sa n lʔaḥruf.
seal/ulum-al-quran/ahruf-qiraat|lines.8: Mraw n lqurraʔ: Nafiɛ, d Ibn Katir, d Abu Ɛamr, d Ibn Ɛamir, d Ɛaṣim, d Ḥamza, d Lkisaʔi (sa), ukan Abu Jaɛfar, d Yaɛqub, d Xalaf.
seal/ulum-al-quran/asbab-nuzul|lines.3: Zɣ lfwayd nns: afham n laya s ufham iṣḥan, asshl n uḥfaḍ d usjhd n lmɛna, d tussna n lḥikma lli ɣ tlla ssebba n ccrɛ.
rashidun/caliph-3|lines.2: Tamsmunt: Zayd mmi-s n Tabit Lʔanṣari, d Ɛbd Llah mmi-s n Zzubayr, d Saɛid mmi-s n Lɛaṣ, d Ɛbd Rraḥman mmi-s n Lḥarit mmi-s n Hicam, iṛḍa Rbbi fllasn.
seal/ulum-al-quran/nuzul|lines.5: Aneggaru n ma d iḍrn: llant gis rriwayat ggutnin, ar ttumyakkant s is kraygatt yat dars aneggaru ɣ ugbur nns.
seal/ulum-al-quran/naskh|lines.2: Tiggayin nns: nnasx n tlawa d lḥukm s sin, nnasx n tlawa iqqim lḥukm, d nnasx n lḥukm tqqim tlawa (ad a iggutn).
seal/ulum-al-quran/naskh|lines.1: Nnasx ɣ lmuṣṭalaḥ: akkas n lḥukm n ccrɛ s yat tmatart n ccrɛ lli d iḍrn ɣ tggira (tggug fllas s wakud).
seal/ulum-al-quran/makki-madani|lines.1: Amadani dar ugar n lɛulama: ma d iḍrn ɣ tggira n lhijra, wakkʷa iḍr ɣ Makka.
rashidun/caliph-3|lines.4: Amxalaf gr sin imunn: amun n Abu Bakr iga s tiggdi ad iǧlu kra zɣ Lqurʔan s lmut n wid t ittasin; amun n Ɛutman iga bac ad mmunn mddn f yan lmuṣḥaf ɣikad iggut umxalaf ɣ wudmawn n lqiraʔa, lʔayat d ssur nns ttusmmasnt.
seal/ulum-al-quran/ahruf-qiraat|lines.0: Lḥadit: mmxalafn Ɛumar mmi-s n Lxaṭṭab d Hicam mmi-s n Ḥakim iṛḍa Rbbi fllasn ɣ tɣuri n ssurt n Lfurqan, inna nnbi ﷺ i kraygatt yan gisn: «Ɣikad a d tḍr», ukan inna: «Lqurʔan iḍr f sa n lʔaḥruf, ɣrat ma ishlan gis».
seal/ulum-al-quran|title: Tussniwin n Lqurʔan: tisura n ufham n Lqurʔan
seal/ulum-al-quran/nuzul|lines.2: Tazdart tamzwarut: s yat tklt s ignna n ddunit ɣ yiḍ n Lqadr.
seal/ulum-al-quran/nuzul|lines.3: Tazdart wis snat: imik s imik f nnbi ﷺ s ufus n Jibril, ɣ 23 n useggʷas.
rashidun/caliph-3|lines.3: Lmṣaḥf lli ttuznnin s tmizar: Lkufi, d Lbaṣri, d Ccami, d Lmadani amatay, d Lmadani uslig (Muṣḥaf Lmam), d yan lqariʔ ar isslmad ayt kraygatt tamazirt.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-qiraat|title: Ibn Ljazari d mraw n lqiraʔat
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-qiraat|lines.0: Abu Ɛubayd Lqasim mmi-s n Sallam: amzwaru n win ittusnan is yura lqiraʔat ɣ yan lktab.
seal/ulum-al-quran/ahruf-qiraat|lines.5: Ṭṭariq: ma ittunsabn i win t iṭṭafn zɣ rrawi niɣ zɣ ɣurs s yan ugʷns.
seal/ulum-al-quran/nuzul|lines.1: Lwaḥy ɣ lmuṣṭalaḥ: ma iwwa Llah subḥanahu wa taɛala i lanbiya nns, ɣifsn ṣṣlat d ssalam, s ufus n Jibril.
seal/ulum-al-quran/ahruf-qiraat|lines.6: Tasnsla: lqariʔ ← rrawi ← ṭṭariq; zund: Nafiɛ (lqariʔ) ← Warc (rrawi) ← Lʔazraq (ṭṭariq), d Qalun rrawi zɣ Nafiɛ, d Ḥafṣ rrawi zɣ Ɛaṣim.
seal/ulum-al-quran/asbab-nuzul|lines.2: Amdya: ﴿وَلَيْسَ اَ۬لْبِرُّ بِأَن تَاتُواْ اُ۬لْبُيُوتَ مِن ظُهُورِهَاۖ﴾ ur ittyafham mzyan abla s tussna n ssebba n nnuzul nns.
seal/ulum-al-quran/ahruf-qiraat|lines.3: Lqariʔ: lmam lli ɣur ittunsab lqiraʔa ar s ittusan.
seal/madani|lines.6: Ṣṣifat iggutn ɣ ssur timadaniyin: afṣṣl n ccrɛ aslmn, asmktay n lamr s ljihad d uḥuḍu f iman, asmktay n lmunafiqin d tigawin nnsn, d tmmaggart n ayt lktab d lɛaqida nnsn
rashidun/caliph-3|lines.1: Ssebba: amxalaf n mddn ɣ wudmawn n lqiraʔa, lli as iwala Ḥuḍayfa mmi-s n Lyaman iṛḍa Rbbi fllas, isnɣl ṣṣuḥuf n Abu Bakr ɣ kigan n lmṣaḥf (tiggura n 24 H d isnti n 25 H).
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-qiraat|lines.2: Lktab nns ittusnan: «Nnacr fi lqiraʔat lɛacr», d tmnḍumt nns «Ṭayyibat nnacr».
seal/ulum-al-quran/naskh|lines.4: Zɣ lḥikma nns: asmuttg imik s imik ɣ ccrɛ, asfsus d usshl, tmuɣli n lmṣaliḥ n imsxxarn, d ukayad n lmukallaf.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-qiraat|lines.1: Ibn Mujahid (immut 324 H): ismun sa n lqiraʔat ɣ lktab nns «Ssabɛa»; isti sa n imam lli ttusnant lqiraʔat nnsn, bddnt dars: Nafiɛ, d Ibn Katir, d Abu Ɛamr, d Ibn Ɛamir, d Ɛaṣim, d Ḥamza, d Lkisaʔi — ur ira ad yini is lqiraʔat iṣḥḥan ur zrint sa.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-qiraat|lines.1: Isimɣur arezzu ɣ lqiraʔat lmutawatira, ismun ibrdan nnsnt isswingm tnt, ismmd mraw n lqiraʔat ɣ tggira n uḍfar n lʔasanid nnsnt.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-qiraat|lines.2: Abu Ɛamr Ddani (immut 444 H): «Ttaysir fi lqiraʔat ssabɛ».
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-4|lines.4: Tussniwin n lala: tussniwin lli ttyusmrasnin d allal i ufham n yat tussna yaḍn, zund nnaḥw d tutlayt d uṣul lfiqh.
seal/ulum-al-quran/nuzul|lines.0: Lqurʔan: awal n Llah, lli d iḍrn f nnbi ﷺ, ar ittyaɛbad Llah s tɣuri nns.
seal/makki/maryam|d1|title: Tamlalt n usnti nns d tggira n ssurt n Lkahf
seal/makki/maryam|d1|b0|label: Ssurt n Maryam d tggira n ssurt n Lkahf
seal/makki/maryam|d1|b0|text: Kraḍt tuqqniwin gr usnti n ssurt n Maryam d tggira n ssurt n Lkahf
seal/makki/maryam|d1|b0.0.1|text: ﴿قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحْمَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّےۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّے جَعَلَهُۥ دَكّاٗ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d1|b0.1.1|text: ﴿قُلِ اِنَّمَآ أَنَا بَشَرٞ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوح۪ىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُۥٓ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d1|b0.2.0|text: ﴿قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٞ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَئْاٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d1|b0.2.1|text: ﴿قُل لَّوْ كَانَ اَ۬لْبَحْرُ مِدَاداٗ لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّے لَنَفِدَ اَ۬لْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّے﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d2|title: Asnti n ssurt d tḥkayt n Zakariya ɣifs ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0|label: Asnti n ssurt d tḥkayt n Zakariya ɣifs ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.0|text: ﴿كَٓه۪ي۪عَٓصَٓۖ ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآءَ (1) ا۪ذْ نَاد۪ىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيّاٗۖ (2) قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّے وَهَنَ اَ۬لْعَظْمُ مِنِّے وَاشْتَعَلَ اَ۬لرَّأْسُ شَيْباٗ وَلَمَ اَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيّاٗۖ (3)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.0.0|text: Ttaḥaddi d liɛjaz s isekkilen ibḍḍan lli ittmyazn s Lqurʔan amakki; isekkilen ad ixṣṣan ssurt n Maryam, ur llin ɣ yat yaḍn
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.0.1|label: Asmktay n rrḥmt n Rbbi nnk i uɛbd nns Zakariya
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.0.1.0|text: Asmktay: bac ad ittyaḍfar ubrid nnsn, d bac ad ittyamẓ ussan n Llah zɣ lḥal n lanbiya d ṣṣiddiqin
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.0.1.2|text: Awal i rrasul ṣalla Llahu ɛalayhi wa sallam; Rrububiya tazlayt
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.0.1.3|text: Amun n usmmqqr zɣ Llah ɛazza wa jall i wid ixṣṣan zɣ imsxxarn nns
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.0|text: Taḥcmt zɣ Llah ɛazza wa jall ﴿ا۪ذْ نَاد۪ىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيّاٗۖ﴾ (3)
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.0.0|text: ﴿وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ فِے نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعاٗ وَخِيفَةٗ وَدُونَ اَ۬لْجَهْرِ مِنَ اَ۬لْقَوْلِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالَاصَالِ وَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ اَ۬لْغَٰفِلِينَۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.0.1|text: ﴿قُلُ اُ۟دْعُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ أَوُ اُ۟دْعُواْ اُ۬لرَّحْمَٰنَۖ أَيّاٗ مَّا تَدْعُواْ فَلَهُ اُ۬لَاسْمَآءُ اُ۬لْحُسْن۪ىٰۖ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلاٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.1|text: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّے وَهَنَ اَ۬لْعَظْمُ مِنِّے وَاشْتَعَلَ اَ۬لرَّأْسُ شَيْباٗ وَلَمَ اَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيّاٗۖ﴾ (4)
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.1.0|label: Attwaḍuɛ i Llah ɛazza wa jall
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.1.0|text: S tmmagra s is ssbab ur llin, d is llan ma ittmnaɛn
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.1.1|text: Iṣfan f Llah ɛazza wa jall, Win iskarn ssbab
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.1.2|label: Tussna nns ɣifs ssalam s Llah ɛazza wa jall
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.1.2|text: Ur jjun dars ifil abla tamsasa n ddɛwa
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.1.3|text: Asmktay n uɣal ifulkin s Llah ɣ yan umkan ittawin s lyas d lqnuṭ acku llan ma ittmnaɛn
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.2|text: ﴿وَإِنِّے خِفْتُ اُ۬لْمَوَٰلِيَ مِنْ وَّرَآءِے وَكَانَتِ اِ۪مْرَأَتِے عَاقِراٗ فَهَبْ لِے مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيّاٗ (4) يَرِثُنِے وَيَرِثُ مِنَ اٰلِ يَعْقُوبَۖ وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيّاٗۖ (5)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.2.0|text: Iga tiggdi f ugdud nns ad uɣuln s lkufr ɣ tggira n lmut nns
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.2.1|text: S usmktay n ma ittmnaɛn ɣ tmṭṭuṭ nns
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.2.2|text: Ar issnfal lamr i Llah ﴿مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيّاٗ يَرِثُنِے﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.3|label: Tamsasa ɣikad, s ma izrin ma ttɣaln mddn
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.3|text: ﴿يَٰزَكَرِيَّآءُ اِ۪نَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ اِ۪سْمُهُۥ يَحْي۪ىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيّاٗۖ﴾ (7)
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.3.0|label: Amzzi ɣ tasga ugar ifulkin n lɛubudiya
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.3.0|text: ﴿لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيّاٗۖ﴾ = ittmyazn, ur dars amtil
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.4|text: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ أَنّ۪ىٰ يَكُونُ لِے غُلَٰمٞ وَكَانَتِ اِ۪مْرَأَتِے عَاقِراٗ وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ اَ۬لْكِبَرِ عُتِيّاٗۖ﴾ (8)
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.4.0|text: Ur immnaɣ d uɣal ifulkin s Llah d lyaqin s tzmmar nns ɛazza wa jall
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.4.1|text: Iga asqsi lli gis lcekk niɣ lʔiɛtiraḍ
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.4.2|text: Gis attr n ufham d tmuɣli ɣ ssbab, s ladab ikmmln d Llah ɛazza wa jall
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.5|label: Awal n Llah d utrr n tmatart
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.5|text: ﴿قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٞ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَئْاٗۖ (8) قَالَ رَبِّ اِ۪جْعَل لِّيَ ءَايَةٗۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ اَ۬لنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٖ سَوِيّاٗۖ (9)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.5.0|label: Yaḥya ɣifs ssalam d awal n Llah
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.5.0|text: «Ili, ar ittili» s lamr nns n ddunit lli ixalfn ssunan d ilugan
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.5.1|text: S «uxlaq n Adam ɣifs ssalam zɣ wakal»: abrid n lyaqin d tussna n tzmmar n Lḥaqq subḥanahu f uxlaq, iɣ llan ssbab niɣ ur llin
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.5.2|text: Ur iga lcekk ɣ lxbar n Llah, iga attr n ulkam s ɛayn lyaqin
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.5.3|text: Tban ɣ yils ifsin ɣ usmktay n Llah «bla yat lɛib», walaynni ur izḍar i wawal
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.6|text: ﴿فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ اَ۬لْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْح۪ىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمُۥٓ أَن سَبِّحُواْ بُكْرَةٗ وَعَشِيّاٗۖ﴾ (11)
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.6.0|text: S nnbi n Llah Yaḥya ɣifs ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.6.1|text: Lbcara n Bani Israʔil s lwaḥy d tmatart ɣas, acku ɣifs ssalam iga iẓum zɣ wawal s lamr n Rbbi nns
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.6.2|text: Lbcara ad tqqan f Bani Israʔil ad tt nmmrn s ttasbiḥ ṣṣbaḥ d tadggʷat
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.7|label: Yaḥya, bab n ttaqwa, iṣfan, ijhdn
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.7|text: Agmu n ddɛwa n Zakariya ɣifs ssalam ﴿وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيّاٗۖ﴾ ﴿يَٰيَحْي۪ىٰ خُذِ اِ۬لْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٖۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ اُ۬لْحُكْمَ صَبِيّاٗۖ (11) وَحَنَاناٗ مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةٗۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيّاٗۖ (12)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.7.0|text: Iṭṭf Yaḥya ɣifs ssalam Ttawrat s tdwast d ujhhd zɣ temẓi nns
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.8|label: Yaḥya, amdya n rrḥmt d lxir i imawlan
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.8|text: ﴿وَبَرّاَۢ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّاراً عَصِيّاٗۖ (13) وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيّاٗۖ (14)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.8.0|text: Ur ittjbbar f lxlq, ur ittɛṣa Lxaliq
seal/makki/maryam|d2|b0.1.8.1|text: Lhna d ssalam ɣ ddunit d laxira ﴿فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d3|title: Taḥkayt n Maryam d Ɛisa ɣifsn ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0|label: Taḥkayt n Maryam d Ɛisa ɣifsn ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.0|text: ﴿وَاذْكُرْ فِے اِ۬لْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ اِ۪نتَبَذَتْ مِنَ اَهْلِهَا مَكَاناٗ شَرْقِيّاٗ (15) فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَاباٗۖ فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَراٗ سَوِيّاٗۖ (16)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.0.0|text: Ɣ tggira n tḥkayt n Zakariya ɣifs ssalam d lmuɛjiza n urba, iwssr, tamṭṭuṭ nns ur tttaru ← taḥkayt n Ɛisa mmi-s n Maryam ar ittlul bla baba
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.0.1|text: Taḥkayt n Zakariya ɣifs ssalam tga tamzwarut i Maryam ɣifs ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.0.2|text: Zɣ ugdud nns, d tilin nns ɣ lmiḥrab nns bac ad tqrrb s Lmawla ɛazza wa jall
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.0.3|text: ﴿فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَاباٗۖ﴾: bac ur tt tḥjjab tmuɣli n lxlq zɣ tifawin n Lḥaqq
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.0.4|text: Tazdart n lmalak Jibril ɣifs ssalam ɣ talɣa n bnadm bac as ibccr s Ɛisa ɣifs ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.1|text: ﴿قَالَتِ اِنِّيَ أَعُوذُ بِالرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيّاٗۖ﴾ (18) — tḥḍa nns s Llah zɣ ɣurs, ilkm tt d ɣ yat talɣa ifulkin; ayad ar issknay
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.1.1|text: Zɣ ubbi n lxlwa nns d ukcam nns bla lidn
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.2|text: ﴿قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِاَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰماٗ زَكِيّاٗۖ﴾ (19)
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.2.0|label: Lbcara nns s tzdart n rrasul n Llah Jibril ɣurs
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.2.0|text: D usgunfu nns ɣifs ssalam d ukkas n tiggdi fllas
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.2.1|label: Lbcara nns s Ɛisa ɣifs ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.2.1|text: Lbcara nns s: zakiy, iṣfa, ibarkn
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.2.2|text: Tiɣufa d ukfa zɣ Rraḥman lli izrin ma ɣaln mddn, zrin tirgitin
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.3|text: ﴿قَالَتَ اَنّ۪ىٰ يَكُونُ لِے غُلَٰمٞ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِے بَشَرٞ وَلَمَ اَكُ بَغِيّاٗۖ﴾ (20)
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.3.0|text: Atɛjjb nns zund atɛjjb n Zakariya ɣifs ssalam ur immnaɣ d tussna nns s Llah ɛazza wa jall d lyaqin nns s tzmmar nns
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.3.1|text: Tumn s awaln n Rbbi nns d rrasul nns
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.3.2|text: Bac ad as yaṛni lyaqin, acku lmawqif iqqur, lmuɛjiza ur dars amtil dat as ... wala ɣ tggira nns
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.4|text: Asmktay nns s lamr n Llah n ddunit d ubayyn n iswi n lmuɛjiza ﴿قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٞۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةٗ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةٗ مِّنَّاۖ وَكَانَ أَمْراٗ مَّقْضِيّاٗۖ﴾ (21)
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.4.0|text: Ahat ad as umnn ar t ttḍfarn
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.4.1|label: Tamatart n rrḥmt n Llah ɛazza wa jall
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.5|text: ﴿فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَانتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَاناٗ قَصِيّاٗۖ (21) فَأَجَآءَهَا اَ۬لْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ اِ۬لنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِے مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نِسْياٗ مَّنسِيّاٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.5.0|text: S tiggdi ad as skrn lbas
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.5.1|text: Ɣ yan lmawqif iqqurn, lmawqif n lmxaḍ d tlalit bla tirmit zik
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.5.2|text: Taḥcmt nns d lɛiffa nns ar tt ttawint ad tiri lmut ugar n umlilli d ugdud nns d tussna nnsn s lamr nns
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.6|text: ﴿فَنَاد۪يٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِے قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيّاٗۖ (23) وَهُزِّےٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ اِ۬لنَّخْلَةِ تَسَّٰقَطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَباٗ جَنِيّاٗۖ (24) فَكُلِے وَاشْرَبِے وَقَرِّے عَيْناٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.6.1|label: Tamzwarut i wawal nns dat ugdud nns
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.6.2|label: Abayyn n lbarakat n Ɛisa ɣifs ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.6.2|text: D usgunfu n innas ɣifs ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.7|text: ﴿فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ اَ۬لْبَشَرِ أَحَداٗ فَقُولِےٓ إِنِّے نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْماٗ فَلَنُ ا۟كَلِّمَ اَ۬لْيَوْمَ إِنسِيّاٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.7.0|text: Immsasa d ummas n ssurt: akfa n Llah d tiɣufa nns i imsxxarn nns
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.7.1|text: Zɣ wawal, d ufrrɣ nns i usmktay n Llah
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.7.2|label: Asusm nns zɣ tririt f ugdud nns
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.7.2|text: ← akkas n tiggdi zɣ umlilli nns d ugdud
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.7.3|label: Asnfl n lamr n tbrriyt nns i Ɛisa ɣifs ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.7.3|text: Acku ccahada nns ugar ijhdn, gis lmuɛjiza
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.8|text: ﴿فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥۖ قَالُواْ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَئْاٗ فَرِيّاٗۖ (26) يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ اِ۪مْرَأَ سَوْءٖ وَمَا كَانَتُ ا۟مُّكِ بَغِيّاٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.8.0|label: Tuɣalin n Maryam ɣifs ssalam s ugdud nns
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.8.0|text: Ɣ tggira n lyaqin nns is Llah ɛazza wa jall ad fllas iḥuḍu
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.8.1|text: Ar issknay lyaqin nns s Llah, is ur tggʷiḍ ugdud, d is tɣal ad frḥn s nnbi nnsn ad as umnn
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.8.2|text: D tuhmt n Maryam ɣifs ssalam s lfaḥica, nttni ssnn lɛiffa nns d ṭṭhara nns
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.8.3|text: D usɛyyr nns s ṣṣalḥin n ugdud nns
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.9|text: ﴿فَأَشَارَتِ اِلَيْهِۖ قَالُواْ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِے اِ۬لْمَهْدِ صَبِيّاٗۖ (28) قَالَ إِنِّے عَبْدُ اُ۬للَّهِ ءَات۪يٰنِيَ اَ۬لْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِے نَبِيٓـٔاٗ (29) وَجَعَلَنِے مُبَٰرَكاً اَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصٰ۪نِے بِالصَّلَوٰةِ وَالزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيّاٗ (30) وَبَرّاَۢ بِوَٰلِدَتِےۖ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِے جَبَّاراٗ شَقِيّاٗۖ (31) وَالسَّلَٰمُ عَلَيَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيّاٗۖ (32)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.9.0|text: Ɣ usnfl n lamr n uḥuḍu i Ɛisa ɣifs ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.9.1|text: Is iga baba, ugar n tbrriyt n inna, i win isdqn s lmuɛjiza
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.9.2|text: Ur immsasa d tilin nns d mmi-s n zzna, ayad iga tabrriyt n inna, i win iskkrksn lmuɛjiza
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.9.3|text: Ar ittini is ayenna ad iḍr s tidt
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.9.4|text: Tamatart n ṭṭhara nns d ṣṣlaḥ nns, d is ur tqqan abla ayad
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.10|text: ﴿ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى اَ۪بْنُ مَرْيَمَۖ قَوْلُ اُ۬لْحَقِّ اِ۬لذِے فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَۖ (33) مَا كَانَ لِلهِ أَنْ يَّتَّخِذَ مِنْ وَّلَدٖۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓۖ إِذَا قَض۪ىٰٓ أَمْراٗ فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُنۖ فَيَكُونُۖ (34) وَأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ رَبِّے وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُۖ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسْتَقِيمٞۖ (35)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.10.0|label: Aǧǧu n usmktay n tririt n ugdud
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.10.0|text: F lḥujjat n Ɛisa ɣifs ssalam
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.10.1|label: Tririt f tggayt lli s umnnin
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.10.1|text: Is iga yan uɛbd zɣ imsxxarn n Llah
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.10.2|text: Zɣ tlla n Lʔuluhiya d Llah ﴿وَأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ رَبِّے وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.10.3|label: Ɛisa ɣifs ssalam iga bnadm d nnbi
seal/makki/maryam|d3|b0.10.3|text: Ad a igan abrid n Llah imsasan, ibɛd zɣ lifraṭ d ttafriṭ
seal/makki/maryam|d4|title: Ass n lḥasra d usmktay n lanbiya
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0|label: Ass n lḥasra d usmktay n lanbiya
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.0|text: ﴿اَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَاتُونَنَاۖ لَٰكِنِ اِ۬لظَّٰلِمُونَ اَ۬لْيَوْمَ فِے ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖۖ (37) وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِيَ اَ۬لَامْرُ وَهُمْ فِے غَفْلَةٖ وَهُمْ لَا يُومِنُونَۖ (38) إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ اُ۬لَارْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَاۖ وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَۖ (39)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.0.1|label: Asggʷdi n ikafrn lli iggiwn i lḥaqq
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.0.1|text: S tbdd nnsn ass n lɛrḍ bac as mmagarn
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.0.2|label: Llah ɛazza wa jall iga Agllid waḥdut
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.0.2|text: Ɣurs ad tuɣul tgldit bac ad iḥkm gr imsxxarn
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.1.0|text: ﴿وَاذْكُرْ فِے اِ۬لْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقاٗ نَّبِيٓـٔاً﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.1.1|text: ﴿اِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِے عَنكَ شَئْاٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.1.2|text: ﴿يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّے قَدْ جَآءَنِے مِنَ اَ۬لْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَاتِكَ فَاتَّبِعْنِےٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطاٗ سَوِيّاٗۖ (43) يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ اِ۬لشَّيْطَٰنَۖ إِنَّ اَ۬لشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيّاٗۖ (44) يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّيَ أَخَافُ أَنْ يَّمَسَّكَ عَذَابٞ مِّنَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيّاٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.1.3|text: ﴿قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ اَنتَ عَنَ اٰلِهَتِےۖ يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَاهْجُرْنِے مَلِيّاٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.1.4|text: ﴿قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّيَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِے حَفِيّاٗ (47) وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَأَدْعُواْ رَبِّے عَس۪ىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّے شَقِيّاٗۖ (48)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.1.5|text: ﴿فَلَمَّا اَ۪عْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَۖ وَكُلّاٗ جَعَلْنَا نَبِيٓـٔاٗۖ (49) وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيّاٗۖ (50)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.2.0|text: ﴿وَاذْكُرْ فِے اِ۬لْكِتَٰبِ مُوس۪ىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلِصاٗ وَكَانَ رَسُولاٗ نَّبِيٓـٔاٗۖ (51) وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ اِ۬لطُّورِ اِ۬لَايْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيّاٗۖ (52) وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيٓـٔاٗۖ (53)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.3.0|text: ﴿وَاذْكُرْ فِے اِ۬لْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ اَ۬لْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولاٗ نَّبِيٓـٔاٗ (54) وَكَانَ يَامُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِالصَّلَوٰةِ وَالزَّكَوٰةِۖ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيّاٗۖ (55)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.4.0|text: ﴿وَاذْكُرْ فِے اِ۬لْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقاٗ نَّبِيٓـٔاٗۖ (56) وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَاناً عَلِيّاًۖ (57)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.5|label: Wid ɣ tgit tiɣufa n Llah d wid d iḍfarn ɣ tggira nsn
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.5.0|text: ﴿ا۟وْلَٰٓئِكَ اَ۬لذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ اَ۬لنَّبِيٓـِٕۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٖ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَآءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَاجْتَبَيْنَآۖ إِذَا تُتْل۪ىٰ عَلَيْهِمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتُ اُ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّواْ سُجَّداٗ وَبُكِيّاٗۖ۩﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d4|b0.5.1|text: ﴿فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ اَضَاعُواْ اُ۬لصَّلَوٰةَ وَاتَّبَعُواْ اُ۬لشَّهَوَٰتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيّاً (59) اِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحاٗ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ اَ۬لْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَئْاٗ (60) جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ اِ۬لتِے وَعَدَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِالْغَيْبِۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَاتِيّاٗۖ (61) لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْواًۖ اِلَّا سَلَٰماٗۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةٗ وَعَشِيّاٗۖ (62) تِلْكَ اَ۬لْجَنَّةُ اُ۬لتِے نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيّاٗۖ (63)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d5|b0.0|text: ﴿وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيّاٗۖ (64) رَّبُّ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَاعْبُدْهُ وَاصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦۖ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيّاٗۖ (65)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d5|b0.1|text: ﴿وَيَقُولُ اُ۬لِانسَٰنُ أَ۟ذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيّاًۖ (66) اَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ اُ۬لِانسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَئْاٗۖ (67)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d5|b0.2|text: ﴿فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جُثِيّاٗۖ (68) ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ اَيُّهُمُۥٓ أَشَدُّ عَلَى اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ عُتِيّاٗۖ (69) ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِالذِينَ هُمُۥٓ أَوْل۪ىٰ بِهَا صُلِيّاٗۖ (70)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d5|b0.3|text: ﴿وَإِن مِّنكُمُۥٓ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْماٗ مَّقْضِيّاٗۖ (71) ثُمَّ نُنَجِّے اِ۬لذِينَ اَ۪تَّقَواْ وَّنَذَرُ اُ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جُثِيّاٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d5|b0.4|text: ﴿وَإِذَا تُتْل۪ىٰ عَلَيْهِمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ قَالَ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَيُّ اُ۬لْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٞ مَّقَاماٗ وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيّاٗۖ (73) وَكَمَ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمُۥٓ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثاٗ وَرِءْياٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d5|b0.5|text: ﴿قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِے اِ۬لضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ اُ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدّاًۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا اَ۬لْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا اَ۬لسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرّٞ مَّكَاناٗ وَأَضْعَفُ جُنداٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d5|b0.6|text: ﴿وَيَزِيدُ اُ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لذِينَ اَ۪هْتَدَوْاْ هُدىٗۖ وَالْبَٰقِيَٰتُ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَاباٗ وَخَيْرٞ مَّرَدّاًۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d5|b0.7|text: ﴿اَفَرَٰٓيْتَ اَ۬لذِے كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالاٗ وَوَلَداً (78) اَطَّلَعَ اَ۬لْغَيْبَ أَمِ اِ۪تَّخَذَ عِندَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْداٗ (79) كَلَّاۖ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ اَ۬لْعَذَابِ مَدّاٗۖ (80) وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَاتِينَا فَرْداٗۖ (81)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d5|b0.8|text: ﴿وَاتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ ءَالِهَةٗ لِّيَكُونُواْ لَهُمْ عِزّاٗ (82) كَلَّاۖ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدّاًۖ (83) اَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا اَ۬لشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى اَ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمُۥٓ أَزّاٗۖ (84) فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمُۥٓۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدّاٗۖ (85) يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ اُ۬لْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْداٗ (86) وَنَسُوقُ اُ۬لْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْداٗۖ (87) لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ اَ۬لشَفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ اِ۪تَّخَذَ عِندَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْداٗۖ (88)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d5|b0.9|text: ﴿وَقَالُواْ اُ۪تَّخَذَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَداٗۖ (89) لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَئْاً اِدّاٗ (90) يَكَادُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ اُ۬لَارْضُ وَتَخِرُّ اُ۬لْجِبَالُ هَدّاً (91) اَن دَعَوْاْ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَداٗۖ (92) وَمَا يَنۢبَغِے لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَنْ يَّتَّخِذَ وَلَداًۖ (93) اِن كُلُّ مَن فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِے اِ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْداٗۖ (94) لَّقَدَ اَحْص۪يٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدّاٗۖ (95) وَكُلُّهُمُۥٓ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْداًۖ (96)﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d5|b0.10|text: ﴿اِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ اُ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدّاٗۖ (97) فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ اِ۬لْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْماٗ لُّدّاٗۖ (98) وَكَمَ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنَ اَحَدٍ اَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزاٗۖ (99)﴾

seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.1|text: Rrḥmt tazlayt d usbdd n lɛizz i wid iẓlayn zɣ imsxxarn ﴿ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآءَ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.1.0.1|text: Lɣrḍ ifulkin s Llah wakkʷa llan imnɛ ﴿رَبِّ إِنِّے وَهَنَ اَ۬لْعَظْمُ مِنِّے﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.1.0.2|label: Asmun n lʔamr i Llah bla ccrṭ
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.1.0.2|text: Iswi nns d tuggdi f ugdud nns ad urrin s tuffɣa dffir nns ﴿فَهَبْ لِے مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيّاٗ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.1.1|label: Tamrrayt ɣ ugaras ugar n mad ittyaɣaln
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.1.1|text: Yan ufrux iẓlayn ur ila amzrus ﴿اِ۪نَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ اِ۪سْمُهُۥ يَحْي۪ىٰ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.1.1.0|text: Asqsi n ufham s ladab, machi s cck ﴿أَنّ۪ىٰ يَكُونُ لِے غُلَٰمٞ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.1.1.1|text: Asuter n laya bac ad yawḍ ɛayn lyaqin ﴿قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٞ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.1.1.2|label: Abccr n Bani Israʔil d ccukr nns s ttasbiḥ
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.1.2|text: Tamrrayt n «Wajɛalhu rabbi raḍiyya» ﴿خُذِ اِ۬لْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٖۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.1.2.1|label: Talwit d ssalam ɣ ddunit d laxirt
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.2|text: Asnwjj i tḥkayt n Ɛisa: ilul bla baba ﴿وَاذْكُرْ فِے اِ۬لْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.2.0|label: Anfaɣ zɣ mddn bac ad tqrrb i Llah
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.2.0|text: Bac ur as tḥjjb tannayt n lxlq tifawin n Lḥqq ﴿فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَاباٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.2.1|label: Listiɛaḍa: tamagit n lɛiffa d lḥyaʔ
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.2.4|text: Almud n rrḥmt n Llah d lʔamr nns ɣ ddunit ﴿وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةٗ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةٗ مِّنَّاۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.2.5|text: Lḥyaʔ nns d lɛiffa nns a tt yiwin ad tmnni lmut ﴿فَأَجَآءَهَا اَ۬لْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ اِ۬لنَّخْلَةِ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.3.0|label: Awal nns d asfɛl i innas d usnwjj i ugdud nns
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.3.0|text: ﴿أَلَّا تَحْزَنِے قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيّاٗۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.3.1|label: Uẓum zɣ wawal d usmun n tbrraʔt i Llah
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.3.2|label: Asikki n ugdud nns wakkʷa ssnn lɛiffa nns
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.3.3|text: Lɛubudiya nns d nnubuwwa nns ar kkasnt asikki ﴿إِنِّے عَبْدُ اُ۬للَّهِ ءَات۪يٰنِيَ اَ۬لْكِتَٰبَ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.3.4|text: Bɛid zɣ lɣuluw d tfrriṭ ﴿وَأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ رَبِّے وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.4|label: Asmɣwas n wid immnɛn ɣ ass n lɛrḍ
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.4|text: Asnti s tsla immsasa d ummas n ddɛwa ﴿اَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَاتُونَنَاۖ﴾
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.4.0|label: Llah waḥdut a igan Lmalik d win ittḥkamn gr imsxxarn
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.5.4|label: Wid f inɛm Llah zɣ lanbiya
seal/makki/maryam|d0|b0.5.4|text: ﴿ا۟وْلَٰٓئِكَ اَ۬لذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ اَ۬لنَّبِيٓـِٕۧنَ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|lines.0: Anaw n ssurt: tamadanit, tga ssurt ilan tiɣzi ugar, d yat zɣ Zzahrawayn.
seal/madani/al-baqara|lines.1: Ssebba n yism: isem nns iqqn s ummasn nns: liman s lɣib, d lbɛt, d usflid d ṭṭaɛa. Taḥkayt n tfunast ar tsmunnu lḥal n Bani Israʔil, d ɣurs a d ttuɣalnt lmɛani n tḥkayin nnsn.
seal/madani/al-baqara|lines.2: Ttaqwa ɣ ssurt: lhidaya n ttawfiq i ayt ttaqwa: liman s lɣib d usllm i lʔamr n ccrɛ, d tussna d tigawt. Lʔaḥkam ttusrssn bac ad zddgn imuminn s lxuluq n ttaqwa, d adɣar nns ulawn.
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.0.0|label: Imttqin: liman s lɣib d usllm
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.0.1|label: Ikfran: tasmmamt f tallalin n ufham
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.0.2|label: Lmunafiqin: lɣcc d waṭṭan n ccubha
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.1.0|text: Alugan n tuzzya d lqiyas n lʔawla. ﴿كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِاللَّهِ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.1.1|text: ﴿هُوَ اَ۬لذِے خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ جَمِيعاٗۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.2|label: Tidt n listixlaf d ccruṭ nns
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.2.1.1|labe: Taḥkayt n tfunast: ttɛnnat d lɛib n ladab
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.2.1.2|labe: Ṣṣifat lli tn ikkisn ɣ lxilafa
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.2.1.2|text: Arẓẓi n lɛuhud, d tḥila, d unkar n nniɛam, d lɛib n ladab d Llah d rrusul nns.
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.2.2.1|text: ﴿رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ اَ۬لسَّمِيعُ اُ۬لْعَلِيمُۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.2.2.2|labe: Ddin iga yan, lḥukm s tigawt machi s lmilla
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.2.2.2|text: ﴿لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٖ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.3.0|text: Lmtiḥan i imuminn d ukmmal n nniɛma d lhidaya n ubddad. ﴿فَلَنُوَلِّيَنَّكَ قِبْلَةٗ تَرْض۪يٰهَاۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.3.2|text: ﴿اُ۪سْتَعِينُواْ بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَوٰةِۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ مَعَ اَ۬لصَّٰبِرِينَۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.0|text: Tawwurt n lḥlal tggut, d ḍḍarurat ar tsḥllal lmaḥḍurat. ﴿كُلُواْ مِمَّا فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ حَلَٰلاٗ طَيِّباٗۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.2.0|text: Ittusrs bac ad tili ttaqwa, imik s imik zɣ ma ifssusn ar ma iẓẓayn. ﴿كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ اُ۬لصِّيَامُ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.2.1|label: Lmaqaṣid n ljihad d ccruṭ nns
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.2.1|text: ﴿وَقَٰتِلُواْ فِے سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِ اِ۬لذِينَ يُقَٰتِلُونَكُمْ وَلَا تَعْتَدُوٓاْۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.3|text: Linfaq, d ljihad ɣ waggur n lḥram, d ccrab d lqmar, d igujiln, d lḥiḍ. ﴿يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.5.0|text: ﴿إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ قَدْ بَعَثَ لَكُمْ طَالُوتَ مَلِكاٗۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.5.0.0|labe: Tuyya d usmɣr n yiman f Llah
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.5.0.2|labe: Nnṣr n lḥqq d ssunna n ttadafuɛ
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.5.1|label: Ssunna n umzzlay wakkʷa tga tuznt yat
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.5.2|text: Asbdd n lijlal d ukmmal d ukkas n kullu ma inqṣn: asizdg d uḥrrz. ﴿اَ۬للَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ اَ۬لْحَيُّ اُ۬لْقَيُّومُۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.5.3|label: Lɛql ad igan aẓar n ttaklif
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.5.4|label: Tigjdit n liman s ass ineggura
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.5.5.0|text: Ɣ ufella ar inqqṣ, d tidt nns ar itzayad. ﴿مَّثَلُ اُ۬لذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ فِے سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.5.5.2|text: ﴿إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ اِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّىٗ فَاكْتُبُوهُۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.2|text: Liman s lɣib s tigjda nns kullu d usflid d ṭṭaɛa, d ukkas n lḥaraj d lmuʔaxaḍa s tuttut d tuccḍa. ﴿سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَاۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَاۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|lines.0: Anaw n ssurt: tamadanit, zɣ ssabɛ ṭṭiwal d yat zɣ Zzahrawayn, tbdu s lḥuruf lmuqaṭṭaɛa, d agbur nns lɛaqida.
seal/madani/al-imran|lines.1: Ssebba n yism: isem nns iqqn s ummas nns: tabnadmit n Ɛisa ɣifs ssalam, d Lislam, d ccahada, d ubddad.
seal/madani/al-imran|lines.2: Ttaqwa ɣ ssurt: ṣṣifat n imttqin: Iyyaka naɛbudu wa iyyaka nastaɛin d ubddad, d timitar nnsn linfaq d uḥbas n wurri d ssmaḥ d listiɣfar. Tidt n ttaqwa ar tbayyan s lmtiḥan n ddrahm d yiman.
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.0|label: Tagant n Llah f Lʔuluhiya nns
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.0|text: ﴿شَهِدَ اَ۬للَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.0.0|label: Lqayyumiya nns ar tsutur tuzna n lktub d tuzna n rrusul
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.0.2|text: ﴿رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.0.3|label: Zɣ ssbab n ubddad: is iga Rrbb d Lmalik

seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.1.1|text: ﴿قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمُۥٓ ءَايَةٞ فِے فِئَتَيْنِ اِ۪لْتَقَتَاۖ﴾

seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.2.3|label: Lmitaq n lanbiya f liman s wid d iddan dffir nsn
