seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.3.2|label: Azzray n lfitna d ucck ɣ wid ixcnn liman
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.3.3|label: Asmnɛ zɣ ubrid n Llah dffir n tussna d tgant
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.3.4|label: Lḥcuma d lɣḍab acku smɣarn yiman f Llah
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.4.1|label: Ṭṭaɛa n Llah ar tsutur ṭṭaɛa n rrasul nns ﷺ
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.4.4|label: Anhay f ussnd f ikfran d lmunafiqin
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.5|text: ﴿إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيس۪ىٰ عِندَ اَ۬للَّهِ كَمَثَلِ ءَادَمَۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.5.1|label: Nnḍr n tmɣart n Ɛimran d tkfalt n Maryam
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.5.1|text: ﴿إِنِّے نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِے بَطْنِے مُحَرَّراٗ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.5.3|label: Axlq nns s «Kun» fa ikun d uḥrrz nns s lmuɛjizat
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.5.4|label: Ddɛwa n ttawḥid d nnṣr n Lḥawariyyin
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.5.5|label: Lḥujja s lqiyas n Adam d ddɛwa s Lmubahala

seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.1.0.0|label: Nnṣr ɣ Badr s uṣbr d ubddad

seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.1.2.1|text: ﴿فَمَا وَهَنُواْ لِمَآ أَصَابَهُمْ فِے سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.1.2.2|label: Lmut s lʔajal machi s ljihad
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.1.2.2|text: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ اَن تَمُوتَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.1.2.4|label: Anhay f rriba d lʔamr s linfaq
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.1.3.0|label: Lmtiḥan d ubayyn n tisgnitin n imsxxarn
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.1.3.1|label: Mddn d tisgnitin ɣ liman d ccahada
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.1.4|text: ﴿وَلَا تَحْسِبَنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ قُتِلُواْ فِے سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِ﴾

seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.1.4.1|label: Ayt lktab ur rbḥn ɣ ufraq n ddrahm d yiman

seal/madani/an-nisa|lines.1: Ssebba n yism: isem nns «Nnisaʔ» iqqn s ummas nns: lɛadl d izrfan n tmɣarin d izrfan n imḍlumn, d lmqam n tmṭṭuṭ s umata.
seal/madani/an-nisa|lines.3: Ttaqwa ɣ ssurt: lʔamr s ttaqwa d usmrɣb gis s usmktay is aẓar n mddn iga yan.
seal/madani/an-nisa|lines.4: Isem n Llah lli iggutn ɣ ssurt: Lmalik: asbdd n lɛadl ur ittili abla s usfru nns, d zɣ ṣṣifat nns Lɣaniy, Lḥamid, Lwakil, Ssamiɛ, Lbaṣir, Lqadir.

seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0.0|label: Aqnaɛ s yat ɣ tuggdi n uḍlam
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0.1|label: Ṣṣdaq ikmmln s tayri n wul
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0.2|label: Asbdd n uzrf nnsnt ɣ lwrt
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0.3|label: Asḥrm n ḍḍrr d usmrɣb ɣ uṣbr
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0.4|label: Lqiwama d sin lḥukkam s tirit n uṣlaḥ
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0.5|label: Liḥsan d umlilli d lbxl ɣ uṣlaḥ

seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.1.1|label: Lmtiḥan n ussfih dat aɛṭṭu n ddrahm nns
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.1.2|label: Lqisma d lfariḍa zɣ dar Llah
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.1.2|text: Lɛql ur iẓḍar i usbdd n lɛadl acku iɣlb t ṭṭbɛ. ﴿فَرِيضَةٗ مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهِۖ﴾
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.2.0|label: Arḍa ɣ lmuɛamalat d unhay f unɣ
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.2.1|label: Urmmas n tugdut iga d lɛadl ikmmln
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.2.1|text: ﴿وَلَا تَتَمَنَّوْاْ مَا فَضَّلَ اَ۬للَّهُ بِهِۦ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٖۖ﴾
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.2.2|label: Lḥukm n Lmalik s lɛadl d liḥsan
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.2.3|label: Arar n lʔamanat d lḥukm s lɛadl
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.3.0|label: Liddiɛaʔ n liman d uḥkam s ṭṭaɣut
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.3.1|label: Tidt n liman: asllm i rrasul ﷺ
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.3.2|label: Ṭṭaɛa n rrasul ﷺ d ṭṭaɛa n Llah
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.3.4|text: ﴿لَا تَتَّخِذُواْ اُ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ﴾
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.3.5|label: Ttuba nnsn s liɛtiṣam d lixlaṣ
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.4.0|label: Aṭṭaf n ssbab bac ad ittyakkas lmkr n uɛdaw
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.4.1|label: Ljihad i Llah, d lmut d lqaḍaʔ d lqadar
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.4.2|label: Anɣ s tuccḍa d unɣ s lqṣd
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.4.2|text: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ لِمُومِنٍ اَنْ يَّقْتُلَ مُومِناًۖ اِلَّا خَطَـٔاٗۖ﴾
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.4.3|label: Lhijra d tasarut n rrizq d tudrt ifulkin
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.4.4|label: Aqṣṣr n tẓallit d tẓallit n tuggdi
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.4.4|text: ﴿وَلْتَاتِ طَآئِفَةٌ ا۟خْر۪ىٰ لَمْ يُصَلُّواْ فَلْيُصَلُّواْ مَعَكَ﴾
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.5|label: Ayt lktab d liman s rrusul
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.5.1|label: Lḥsad nnsn f nniɛma n nnubuwwa
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.5.2|label: Lḥukm s tigawt machi s lʔamani
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.5.4|label: Tuzna n rrusul bac ad tbdd lḥujja
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.5.4|text: ﴿لِيَ۬لَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى اَ۬للَّهِ حُجَّةُۢ بَعْدَ اَ۬لرُّسُلِۖ﴾
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.5.5|label: Awal n lɛadl ɣ Ɛisa ɣifs ssalam
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.5.5|text: ﴿إِنَّمَا اَ۬لْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى اَ۪بْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولُ اُ۬للَّهِ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|lines.0: Anaw n ssurt: tamadanit s lʔijmaɛ, tḍr dffir n lhijra d dffir n ssurt n Lfatḥ, s imik s imik. Lʔaḥkam nns muḥkama, ur gis lmansux.
seal/madani/al-maida|lines.1: Ssebba n yism: «Lmaʔida» ar tsmunnu ummasn nns: lḥlal d lḥram ɣ tirmt, d Lmalik subḥanahu, d uḥḍu n lɛuhud. Zɣ ismawn nns: Lɛuqud, Lmunqiḍa, Lʔaxyar.
seal/madani/al-maida|lines.2: Ttaqwa ɣ ssurt: alugan n uḥḍu n lɛuqud: ad ur ismɣar yan yiman f lḥudud n Llah; lḥlal ayenna isḥlla Lmalik, d lḥram ayenna isḥrm.
seal/madani/al-maida|lines.3: Isem n Llah lli iggutn ɣ ssurt: Lmalik subḥanahu: lɛizz, tazmert, lḥikma, tussna d lɛadl.
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0|label: Aḥḍu n lɛuqud d Lmalik ← lḥukm i nttan ɣ lḥlal d lḥram
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.0|text: Tawwurt n lḥlal tggut, d tawwurt n lḥram tdrus. ﴿أُحِلَّتْ لَكُم بَهِيمَةُ اُ۬لَانْعَٰمِ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.0.0|label: Tiggut n lḥlal: ṭṭayyibat d tirmt n ayt lktab
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.0.1|text: ﴿فَمَنُ اُ۟ضْطُرَّ فِے مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٖ لِّإِثْمٖ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.0.2|label: Asmɣwas f usḥrm n lḥlal s lɣuluw
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.0.2|text: ﴿لَا تُحَرِّمُواْ طَيِّبَٰتِ مَآ أَحَلَّ اَ۬للَّهُ لَكُمْ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.0.4|label: Ṣṣid: lmtiḥan n liman s lɣib
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.0.5|label: Lbaḥira d ssaʔiba: ccrɛ bla almud
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.0.5|text: ﴿مَا جَعَلَ اَ۬للَّهُ مِنۢ بَحِيرَةٖ وَلَا سَآئِبَةٖ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1|label: Aḥḍu n lɛuqud d urmmas n urẓẓi nnsn
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1|text: Amdya n urẓẓi: Bani Israʔil. ﴿وَاذْكُرُواْ نِعْمَةَ اَ۬للَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمِيثَٰقَهُ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.0|text: Ccukr n nniɛma d ccrṭ n tɣzzi nns. ﴿إِذْ قُلْتُمْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَاۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.1.0|label: Arẓẓi n lɛhd d tuttut nns d ljazaʔ nns
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.1.0|text: Llaɛna d uqqur n wulawn, d lɛdawa d lbɣḍ. ﴿فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِم مِّيثَٰقَهُمْ لَعَنَّٰهُمْ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.1.1|label: Akal imqqḍsn: arẓẓi n ifrxan nnsn
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.1.1|text: Urmmas n lyaqin d ttawakkul, ittusḥrm fllasn wakal. ﴿فَاذْهَبَ اَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَٰتِلَآ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.2|label: Lḥurma n yiman d lmitaq n ssalam
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.2.0|label: Sin tarwa n Adam: lḥsad dat anɣ
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.2.1|label: Lḥiraba d takrḍa: ljazaʔ s lqddr n lfsad
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.3|text: Lḥnana i umumn d lɛizz f ukafr. ﴿فَسَوْفَ يَاتِے اِ۬للَّهُ بِقَوْمٖ يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُۥٓ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.4|label: Aḥḍu n tgalliyin d urar n tgant
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.2|label: Lḥukm s ma iẓn Llah acku iga Lmalik
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.2|text: Tuffɣa nns d lkufr d uḍlam d lfsq. ﴿وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ اَ۬للَّهُ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْكَٰفِرُونَۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.2.0|text: Lɛibra s tigawt d ukmmal machi s tiqqit. ﴿وَلِلهِ مُلْكُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.2.1|text: ﴿لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ اَ۬لذِينَ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ هُوَ اَ۬لْمَسِيحُ اُ۪بْنُ مَرْيَمَۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.2.2|text: Azzrb ɣ lkufr, d ubddl, d ucc n ssuḥt. ﴿لَا يُحْزِنكَ اَ۬لذِينَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِے اِ۬لْكُفْرِ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.2.3|label: Lqurʔan issṭṭfarn d lmhimin f lktub
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.2.3|text: ﴿مُصَدِّقاٗ لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ اَ۬لْكِتَٰبِ وَمُهَيْمِناً عَلَيْهِۖ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.2.4|label: Asmɣwas f lmuwalat n wudayn d nnṣara
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.2.5|label: Ass n lfaṣl: ar tnfa wid iṣdqn tidt nnsn
